Amar Shaheed Baba Ajit Singh Jujhar Singh Memorial College of Pharmacy fees ranges between INR 80,000 to 4,34,000. The student intake for these courses is 284. reviews_list.review_title: Infrastructure is good and clean. A well maintained campus with friendly lecturers and professors.

review_content.Placements: Many top companies visit regularly for placements. Many companies like Himalaya, Cipla, Leoford, and all of them visit our campus. There are even some placement cells that want to teach how to handle the interview placements. Top roles offered are pharmacist, dispensing clinical pharmacy medical script writers, drug inspector, quality analyst in QC and QA department.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college provides Wi-Fi access, spacious classrooms, good atmosphere, and food is very tasty for Indians which may vary individual to individual. There is Nagaratnamma stadium which is a very big stadium on our campus for cricket. Even basketball court, volleyball court, and many other indoor games are available with equipped gym and swimming pool.

reviews_list.review_title: All over the college is very good.

review_content.Placements: Placements of Acharya are very good. Almost more than 10,000 companies visit our campus to recruit students. Our top recruiters are Cipla, Himalaya, Biocon, and Lupin. Our placement percentage is 95%. The highest package goes to 50 LPA. Most of the students got placed in our college with the average package of 6 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is very good. Everything is available as per your needs on our college campus. Lab and classes are very good. They provide Wi-Fi connection. Lab contains so many instruments. Hostel has so many facilities like carrom, chess, badminton court, swimming pool, etc. Food quality of the hostel is very good and healthy.

reviews_list.review_title: Our college is very good for B. Pharmacy with better placements.

review_content.Placements: Most of the students get placements every year with an attractive salary package of 7 LPA to 8 LPA. Well-reputed companies from the pharmaceutical field come to offer placements with good salary packages. Mostly quality assurance and regulatory affairs are the roles offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has well-designed and well-equipped labs with sufficient chemicals to perform practicals. Hostel facilities are better and are available separately for boys and girls. Food served in the hostel mess is average.

reviews_list.review_title: Overall, I'm highly satisfied with the facilities provided.

review_content.Placements: Around 70% of the students got placed in my course. The highest package offered is 30,000 per month, and 15,000 per month is the lowest salary. Mylan, Medchem, etc., are the recruiting companies. Almost 80% of students got internships in various companies. Drug inspector and pharmaceutical marketing are the top roles offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus is very well maintained. Classrooms are big. A large variety of books are available in the library. It has a huge stadium along with good sports facilities. Labs are neat and clean. LCD screens are available in the classrooms for digital classes. The hostel is neat and clean and well-furnished. Food is very good. Medical facilities are available.

reviews_list.review_title: I am a bit satisfied with the college.

review_content.Placements: Many companies like Medchem and Mylan visit here to hire students, and last time I saw a Dubai-based company visited to recruit students. Our seniors are working in many other companies. They also got an internship from college and heading towards their success.
review_content.Infrastructure: Everything is good here except for food quality in the hostel. I am not staying in the hostel since the past one year. So I don't know whether they improved or not, but they need to change the contract for food to provide a good quality of food.

reviews_list.review_title: If you want to be legend in your branch and get a secure placement, I suggest Acharya is best.

review_content.Placements: According to the alumni, if you score well, you can get good placements here. I heard from my seniors that, overall 80% students got good placements from here and many good companies visit Acharya. Especially for pharmacy, you can get a good job by joining here.
review_content.Infrastructure: For infrastructure and architecture, this is the second best college in Bangalore. If you don't come here, you won't get any idea about the campus. Acharya is laid across 120 acres of the campus. You can find different blocks for different departments. And the most important thing is the playground.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Very good and prestigious college with good reviews.

content.Placements: Almost 70 to 80 percent of students are placed in various companies. The highest package of this college is 16.80 LPA, and the average package is 4 to 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Suzuki, Deloitte, etc. Almost every student gets an internship in various fields in different companies.
content.Infrastructure: There is a very good infrastructure in the college with neat and clean classrooms. The whole college has Wi-Fi facilities, modern labs, and a library with many types of technical books. The college has separate hostels for girls and boys. Food is very good and hygienic.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: HIT is good for value for money, and with a good ROI, you have to work hard here.

content.Placements: In my course, approximately 70% students got placement with an average of 4-5 LPA. Some have been offered 10-12 LPA also. But not alot company has been came in campus for specialization. An ML engineer is the main role offered in my course. Teamplus like company, has recruited the students and senior suggest study, you will get a placement.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is good except the first semester. As the machines are old, the remaining library and all are so beautiful, there is no boys' hostel facility in the college, and so it's difficult for the students outside West Bengal. Mess and canteen food is delicious and good at less than a little. Affordable price, sports and games are, but you have to carry the expenses.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Narula Institute of Technology, the college you can't regret.

content.Placements: Approximately 60-70 percent of students got placed from my course. The highest package is 27 LPA, the lowest is 6 LPA, and the average is around 8 LPA-9 LPA. Recruiting companies are Cognizant, TCS, etc. In the Big 4, you can get internships. Roles offered are AI and ML engineer, analyst roles, developer roles, SDE roles, manager, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. Not upto the mark but by far I'll say good. Small campus and things, you'll feel like you're still in school. Food quality is decent. Also, there's a cafeteria and canteen so you get food for really cheap and there are cafes too in front of the college so you will not face any problem. The hostel is outside the campus because the campus is very small like 5 acres.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Decent college, decent placement, average faculty.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students got placed. "Senco Gold" was the top recruiter with a 3.6 LPA package, and the lowest was 1.2 LPA. The top role offered was Sales Intern. 100% of students got an internship in various companies like Biskfarm, TCS, Senco Gold, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is satisfactory. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained, and basic facilities, such as the library, labs, and Wi-Fi, are available. The food is good, and both veg and non-veg options are available. The hostel is also very clean, and every basic need is available, like AC/Non-AC rooms with fan, light, gas for cooking, washing machines, and other essential things.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college is surrounded by nature and greenery.

content.Placements: 70 to 80 percent of people from our previous batch are placed. The average package is 5 LPA and the highest package is 12 LPA. The whole batch is provided with internship. The faculty is great they provide you with trips and great skills that help you crack the internship easily.
content.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi available, the classrooms are pretty decent and the library has ample amount of books. The labs are pretty good. If we talk about mess food, they have lots of variety from veg to non veg.
content.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable and hold a strong degree and will always try to help you professionally and personally. They will help you with literally everything. They have knowledge that will help you with academics. They provide great support and help you build the skill.

admission_overview.title: MAKAUT Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: MAKAUT, also known as Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, offers UG, PG, and doctoral programmes. The courses cover the domains of Engineering, Science, Arts and Social Sciences etc. Admission process at MAKAUT is entrance based. MAKAUT accepts a few more state/ national-level exams for admission, such as WBJEE, PGET, UGC NET (including JRF)/ CSIR NET for admission to other UG, PG and doctoral-level programmes. The university also conducts its own entrance exam, JEMAT, for admission into MBA and MHA courses. Applications for all the offered courses are accepted strictly in the online mdoe. Offline applications are not entertained at all. The duration of most UG courses is three to four years, with PG programmes extending up to two years. Read on to know more aboiut eligibility, admission and application process, fees etc. at MAKAUT.

admission_process.title: MAKAUT Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: MAKAUT conducts an entrance exams to select candidates for specific courses. Candidates can check the deatiled steps below:
Step 1: MAKAUT Application Process 2026

Candidates fulfilling the eligibility requirements can apply online for MAKAUT admission. As per the information collated from the web, aspirants must pay an application fee to register for a course. Fill the form and upload the specified documents to complete the application process.
Step 2: Selection Process

MAKAUT shortlists candidates for most of the courses based on the entrance exam conducted by the university. To appear for the exam, download the MAKAUT admit card. The university considers entrance exams such asWBJEE, PGCET, etc. for admission to specific courses. The first level of selection after the application process will be either based on the entrance exam or academic merit.
Step 3: Merit List & Counselling

After the completion of selection rounds, the exam conducting body declares a merit list to announce the selected candidates names. Further, selected students are called for counselling and document verification round. You also need to payMAKAUT feeto confirm your seat in the university.

faqs.question: Can I change my college under MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: No, candidates do not have the option to change their college under Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology. If they wish to change, they are required to appear for the necessary entrance test again. However, a few articles on the internet mention that students can change their college after the first year but they are required to clear all the exams of the first year for the same. For better clarity on the subject, candidates are advised to reach out to the admission office of MAKAUT or the affiliated institute under the university.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to B.Tech at MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to B.Tech must have a valid score in WBJEE. Those willing to get admission in the second year must appear for JELET (for Lateral Entry). In addition to this, MAKAUT also conducts JEMAT for admission to MBA and Maharashtra courses. Moreover, the university also accepts a few more state/ national-level exams for admission which include WBJEE. PGET, UGC NET (including JRF)/ CSIR NET for admission to other UG, PG and doctoral-level programmes.

faqs.question: How many seats are there for MSc in MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: MAKAUT offers a total of1548 seatsfor its MSc programme. These seats are distributed among more than more than 10 affiliated colleges of the university. Some of the colleges included are the Institute of Management Study, Guru Nanak Institute of Pharmaceutical Science and Technology, and more.

faqs.question: Which exam is required for admission to BCA at MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: MAKAUT offers a full-time BCA programme. In order to get admission, students must appear for CET. It is conducted byMAKAUT WB. Candidates must have qualified Class 12 to appear for this exam.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Sanaka Educational Trust's Group of InstitutionsReviewed on 22 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Very good and prestigious college with good reviews.
reviews.review_text: There is a very good infrastructure in the college with neat and clean classrooms. The whole college has Wi-Fi facilities, modern labs, and a library with many types of technical books. The college has separate hostels for girls and boys. Food is very good and hygienic.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Heritage Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 22 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: HIT is good for value for money, and with a good ROI, you have to work hard here.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good except the first semester. As the machines are old, the remaining library and all are so beautiful, there is no boys' hostel facility in the college, and so it's difficult for the students outside West Bengal. Mess and canteen food is delicious and good at less than a little. Affordable price, sports and games are, but you have to carry the expenses.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by NIT - Narula Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Narula Institute of Technology, the college you can't regret.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Not upto the mark but by far I'll say good. Small campus and things, you'll feel like you're still in school. Food quality is decent. Also, there's a cafeteria and canteen so you get food for really cheap and there are cafes too in front of the college so you will not face any problem. The hostel is outside the campus because the campus is very small like 5 acres.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by iLEAD KolkataReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Decent college, decent placement, average faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is satisfactory. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained, and basic facilities, such as the library, labs, and Wi-Fi, are available. The food is good, and both veg and non-veg options are available. The hostel is also very clean, and every basic need is available, like AC/Non-AC rooms with fan, light, gas for cooking, washing machines, and other essential things.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by NSHM Institute of Engineering and Technology - NSHM Knowledge Campus DurgapurReviewed on 18 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The college is surrounded by nature and greenery.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi available, the classrooms are pretty decent and the library has ample amount of books. The labs are pretty good. If we talk about mess food, they have lots of variety from veg to non veg.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by Swami Vivekananda Institute of Science and TechnologyReviewed on 18 Jan 2026)

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Haldia Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)

reviews_list.review_title: Honest review of the BCA course at DIT University, Dehradun.

review_content.Placements: I am from the BCA batch at DIT University, Dehradun. In our course, around 70-80 percent of students got placed. The highest package offered ranges from 10-12 LPA. The average package ranges between 3-5 LPA. The lowest package ranges from 2-3 LPA. Many well-known companies like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Capgemini, Tech Mahindra, HCL, and Deloitte visit the college for placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the course is good. The campus has full Wi-Fi. It has well-equipped computer labs, smart classrooms, and a large library with digital resources. The hostel facilities are decent and safe. The mess food is average but manageable. The canteen offers a greater variety of food. Medical facilities are available on campus. Sports grounds and indoor games are also provided. Overall, the infrastructure supports the sports academy and students' lives.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science and Analytics) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: DIT University offers a well-structured curriculum.

review_content.Placements: Around 90 percent of students are placed through campus recruitment. The highest package offered to our batch is between 30 LPA-35 LPA, the average is 6 LPA-7 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3.5 LPA. The major roles offered to students included Software Developer, Data Analyst, and Web Developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the B.Tech course at DIT University is impressive and well-maintained. The department provides high-speed Wi-Fi across the academic clock, well-equipped computer labs, modern classrooms with projectors, and a library that has a strong collection of technical books.

The major roles of BCA graduates were software developers, web developers, system analysts, technical support engineers, database administrators, and IT consultants.

In addition, candidates who do not have any of the scores mentioned above need to sit and appear for merit-based counselling on DUET followed by PI.

hostel.description: The hostel accommodation comprises of American style apartments which are well furnished, hygienic and have ultramodern amenities. Each apartment has three rooms shared by two students each, a lobby and attached bathrooms. The hostel premises has common TV room, tuck-shops (having stationary, barber, bakery, juice etc. shops) and state of the art indoor and outdoor sports facilities. The entire hostel premises are Wi-Fi enabled and has a separate computer centre with 24X7 internet facility. There are four in-campus boys' hostel viz. All hostel blocks are equipped with solar water heaters with heating elements which provide warm water in the hostels all year round.

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of the BCA course at DIT University, Dehradun.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the course is good. The campus has full Wi-Fi. It has well-equipped computer labs, smart classrooms, and a large library with digital resources. The hostel facilities are decent and safe. The mess food is average but manageable. The canteen offers a greater variety of food. Medical facilities are available on campus. Sports grounds and indoor games are also provided. Overall, the infrastructure supports the sports academy and students' lives.

reviews.review_heading: DIT University offers a well-structured curriculum.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the B.Tech course at DIT University is impressive and well-maintained. The department provides high-speed Wi-Fi across the academic clock, well-equipped computer labs, modern classrooms with projectors, and a library that has a strong collection of technical books.

reviews.review_heading: My experience as a BCA student at DIT University.
reviews.review_text: The campus has Wi-Fi everywhere. Computer labs are modern and well-equipped. Classrooms are clean and have smart boards. Library is big, peaceful, and has digital resources. There is a good environment for studying and projects. Hostels are clean and safe with Wi-Fi. Rooms available in single, double, and triple sharing. There is 24/7 security and warden support.

reviews.review_heading: Great college according to the environment, exposure and fests.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is pretty good, classrooms are well-equipped, Wi-Fi connectivity is slow, however, the library is good with all course books available and labs are well maintained. Physics labs are provided with all the setup and equipment, and computer labs have good connectivity of Wi-Fi, hence no issues with Wi-Fi while using computers.

reviews.review_heading: DIT University is one of the top universities in Uttarakhand for B.Tech CSE.
reviews.review_text: DIT University has a campus of 24 acres and provides various facilities like high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped and advanced labs, technology-advanced and ICT-enabled classrooms. The Hostel facility provided by DIT offers clean and hygienic mess food, a well-equipped gym with a qualified trainer, indoor and outdoor sports facilities, various club activities,  24/7 medical assistance, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Disappointing if you're looking for an OG college regarding placement.
reviews.review_text: Most of the facilities that you can think of are available. The Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are pretty good. The architecture is nice, and the nature around the campus is breathtaking (reconfirming to you that it's all about nature, not the "packages"). The mess serves okay food, and canteens are available and serve pretty well. There are medical facilities not specifically targeted at sports, but yes, they exist—not at a bigger level, but it's fine.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with strong faculty members and decent placement. Overall, a great experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The mess food is also very good. Wi-Fi is also available 24X7. The library has a good collection of books in the library.

reviews.review_heading: DIT Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand, is one of the best engineering colleges.
reviews.review_text: DIT University in Dehradun offers a high-quality infrastructure and facilities, including well-maintained Wi-Fi-enabled spaces, libraries, labs, a hostel, a rooftop, and a sports ground. Hostel has A1 facilities, including a mess and common areas. College has both girls' and boys' hostel. College also has A1 quality facilities available to solve each and every doubt of students.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with a beautiful campus. Overall, it is a good choice.
reviews.review_text: Here at DIT University infrastructure is good. The location is brilliant. Classrooms are good and labs are excellent. It has decent hotels. It has a nice, clean, clear, and beautiful campus as well.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great university situated in the foothills of Mussoorie.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available everywhere, though it doesn’t always work well. The library is grand, and all required books are available; it is also air-conditioned. Classrooms can feel very hot during the summer. The hostel is decent, though it can feel suffocating; the food is not that great. It’s neither hygienic nor tasty.

reviews.review_heading: It has good facilities and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of both classes and hostels is very nice. Classrooms and labs are spacious and have good working space. The hostel rooms are well-ventilated, managed, and clean. Facilities provided in the hostel are drinking water, 4 times meals in a mess, and a confectionery shop for emergency uses. Medical facilities are common for the college and hostel, and they are well-managed. Hostels have playgrounds, a court, and gym facilities too. The food is average.

reviews.review_heading: College of activities and exploration.
reviews.review_text: There are over 350 ICT-enabled classrooms and more than 80 state-of-the-art laboratories. The VEDA library spans 2500 square feet and boasts over 1400 computers. It also features a 500-seat air-conditioned room. The hostel can accommodate 1200 boys and 1000 girls. The campus features multiple cafeterias.

reviews.review_heading: Solid infrastructure and decent academics.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are average, and the infrastructure is good. The library is good, but there is a problem, it's not open 24 hours. But during exam time, it is open until 3 o'clock at night. The Wi-Fi is not so good. The classrooms are big and good, but the mess food is not so good.

reviews.review_heading: I suggest that this college has good infrastructure and facilities. Thank you.
reviews.review_text: Our college includes good Wi-Fi and labs such as the computer lab, chemistry lab, physics lab, and biology lab for nursing students. The library is also very good, with many useful books. The quality of the mess food is good, and there are facilities for doctors, sports, games, and a canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: There is completely established Wi-Fi throughout the campus.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in MJPRU Bareilly?
faqs.answer: MJPRU Bareilly admissions are both merit and entrance-based for respective UG and PG courses. For a few UG courses such as BA, BSc, BCom, etc., admissions are offered based on candidates' merit scores obtained in their last qualifying exam. Further, to get admission to courses such as LLB, MEd, MSc, etc., candidates have to qualify for the university-level entrance exam. For other UG and PG courses, Rohilkhand University accepts a valid scores of CUET UG and CUET PG entrance exams. Later on, the selected students are allocated seats via a counselling process. faqs.question: Can I take direct admission at MJPRU?
faqs.answer: MJPRU admissions are either entrance or merit-based. Candidates have to qualify for the minimum eligibility criteria to apply for any of the UG & PG courses. Apart from that for courses such as BPharm, BTech, MBA, MCA, etc., the university accepts valid scores of JEE Main, CUET UG & CUET PG entrance exams. Further, for other UG courses, admissions are entirely based on the merit obtained in the previous qualifying exam.

Also, candidates need to fulfil the eligibility criteroa for admissions. reviews_list.review_title: Don't take admission in this college.

review_content.Placements: About 20% of students got placed. The highest package was 4 LPA, and the lowest was 2 LPA. Recruiting companies such as pharmaceuticals came last year. There was no internship provided by the college, you had to do it on your own. You should not expect the placement from this college at all.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure both were not very well maintained. Library was maintained with a lot of books. Classrooms did not have projectors, and the Wi-Fi was available for the staff only. The food in the mess was not that good, it's average. Medical facilities were there. College had it's own hospital where students get 5% to 10% discount. Sports and athletics were pretty good.

reviews_list.review_title: I'll not suggest that you take admission in this college.

review_content.Placements: The placement scenario isn't very promising. Only around 20%-25% students got placed last year. The highest package offered was approximately 7 LPA, and the lowest was around 3.5 LPA. Most of the offers came from service-based companies, and internships weren't offered to everyone. There isn't much focus on practical knowledge, which affects how industry-ready students are. Core jobs are quite rare in this course.
review_content.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure is decent. Classrooms are clean and equipped with projectors, and there's good Wi-Fi in academic blocks. Labs are there, but not always well-maintained. The library helps with studying, but it is a bit outdated in terms of resources. Hostels are fine, though not very spacious. Mess food is average, some days it's okay, some days not so much. There's a small medical room and basic sports facilities, nothing fancy but manageable.

review_summary.college_name: SHUATS Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.title: Faculty members are good. No college life, no fest, nothing.

content.Placements: Approximately 35-40% placement in the corporate field. Many prefer to go for higher studies and government jobs. Many big companies come during placement like Amul, etc. Students got scholarships like UP scholarship, but this is only for UP people. There are various roles offered in this course like AFO, KVK scientist, etc. There are various roles on the marketing side, also.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructures are not that good. All buildings are very old, and the fee is a little bit high. Our classrooms are also not that good. Hostels are okay; I mean, it's average. The mess is not so good; sometimes it's good, and sometimes it's bad, like every other mess. No facilities like a good canteen, sports, and games. We don't have anything to play.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Radiodiagnosis and Imaging Techniques) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is average and not so good at anything.

content.Placements: Placements are average. Around 40-45 percent of students got placed from our batch. The highest package is 3 LPA, but most students got the average package. A few well-known companies visit the college, but not regularly. Internships are available, but mostly through self-effort. Roles offered are mainly technician or assistant level.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. Labs are well-maintained, and we have proper equipment for practicals. Classrooms are comfortable, and Wi-Fi worked fine. The library has enough books. Hostel rooms are clean. The food quality is decent, though sometimes repetitive. Sports area is small but useful.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Radiodiagnosis and Imaging Techniques) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Don't take admission in this college.

content.Placements: About 20% of students got placed. The highest package was 4 LPA, and the lowest was 2 LPA. Recruiting companies such as pharmaceuticals came last year. There was no internship provided by the college, you had to do it on your own. You should not expect the placement from this college at all.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure both were not very well maintained. Library was maintained with a lot of books. Classrooms did not have projectors, and the Wi-Fi was available for the staff only. The food in the mess was not that good, it's average. Medical facilities were there. College had it's own hospital where students get 5% to 10% discount. Sports and athletics were pretty good.

individual_reviews.title: I'll not suggest that you take admission in this college.

content.Placements: The placement scenario isn't very promising. Only around 20%-25% students got placed last year. The highest package offered was approximately 7 LPA, and the lowest was around 3.5 LPA. Most of the offers came from service-based companies, and internships weren't offered to everyone. There isn't much focus on practical knowledge, which affects how industry-ready students are. Core jobs are quite rare in this course.
content.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure is decent. Classrooms are clean and equipped with projectors, and there's good Wi-Fi in academic blocks. Labs are there, but not always well-maintained. The library helps with studying, but it is a bit outdated in terms of resources. Hostels are fine, though not very spacious. Mess food is average, some days it's okay, some days not so much. There's a small medical room and basic sports facilities, nothing fancy but manageable.

individual_reviews.title: You can take admission but don't expect much.

content.Placements: Last year, only a few students got placed. The placement scenario wasn't that great. Only around 20 percent of students were placed. The highest package offered was around 8 LPA, the lowest was 4 LPA but most students didn't even get placement opportunities. Only a few companies came for recruitment and most of them offered internships instead of full-time roles. The overall placement support also felt a bit lacking.
content.Infrastructure: The college has decent infrastructure. Classrooms are spacious and have projectors and there's Wi-Fi across the campus, though the speed can be inconsistent. Labs are well-equipped and the library has a good collection of books. The hostel is okay. Rooms are a bit small but manageable. Mess food is average sometimes better on special days. There are sports facilities and a few indoor games. Medical facilities are available but could be improved. Overall, not bad but not the best either.

faqs.question: What is JEE 2023 Counselling schedule at SHUATS?
faqs.answer: SHUATS (Sam Higginbottom University of Agriculture, Technology and Sciences) does not participate in JEE Main Counselling 2023 conducted by JoSAA (Joint Seat Allocation Authority). Therefore, there is no JEE 2023 Counselling schedule at SHUATS. However, SHUATS conducts its own counseling process for admission to its engineering courses. Candidates who have qualified for JEE Main 2023 and meet the eligibility criteria for SHUATS can apply for admission to the university through its counseling process. Candidates are advised to check the official website of the university for updates on the counseling process.

faqs.question: How are MBA placements at SHUATS Allahabad?

The average package was around 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies were BARE, Syngenta and VNR Seeds etc. The top roles offered were like HR, CEO.

placements.overview:
Y. B. Chavan College of Pharmacy, is located in Aurangabad, Maharashtra. Established in 1989, it is a private institute approved by AICTE. Y. B. Chavan College of Pharmacy provides 5 UG and PG courses in 2 specialisations, namely Pharmaceutical and Pharmacology. Theses programmes are offered in Full Time mode. B.Pharma and M.Pharma are some of the courses offered at Y. B. Chavan College of Pharmacy. Some of the stream in which these courses are offered include Medicine & Health Sciences. The total fee at Y. B. Chavan College of Pharmacy ranges between INR 3,33,672 to 4,55,652. Y. B. Chavan College of Pharmacy has a student intake of 160 for all the courses. The average median package at Y. B. Chavan College of Pharmacy is INR 2,79,600. Y. B. Chavan College of Pharmacy offers all the infrastructural facilities to students.

Q. Y.B. Chavan College of Pharmacy offers courses in which field?

A. Y.B. Chavan College of Pharmacy offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes in the field of Pharmacy.

review_content.Placements: About 70 to 80 average students were placed. The average or lowest package is about 2-3 LPA. review_content.Infrastructure: The classroom was good and is full of facilities. It has a Wi-Fi connection, and smart classrooms are available. The library is really very good, and all departments and their assistants are really very supportive and helpful. I am not a hosteler, but the hostel facility is also good.

reviews_list.review_title: Best college for pharmacy.

review_content.Placements: This is an autonomous college so placements compared to other colleges need to be high. Placements are very low. The percentage of students who got placed is very low in the college. In the previous year, the highest package offered to a student was 3 LPA. MSD animal health and mebibyte companies came for placements
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities in the college are very good. The infrastructure is very clean and big. Classrooms in this college have a capacity of 60 students. The Wi-Fi facility is provided. Each department has separate practical labs. The food quality of the mess is average. The canteen is also there in the college. All sports and games are played in this college.

reviews_list.review_title: Choose autonomous for industry-ready.

review_content.Placements: There was less placement ratio. Hardly one or two students were placed during the placement period. Small pharma recruiting companies that did not provide big packages. In B. Pharmacy in my time, only two companies came for placements. The highest salary package offered was 3 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Best facilities and infrastructure were there at this college in Sambhaji Nagar. Unlimited Wi-Fi access was provided to students. Labs were very big with all the pharam-related instruments. Library was also big with vast number of books. But for library, we need to pay an extra charge. Separate canteen was available at this college.

reviews_list.review_title: The college is autonomous and making students placement ready.

review_content.Placements: The college is autonomous, and the placements start from the 1st sem of M. Pharmacy. There are CGPA criteria for placement. Top companies like Biotic Healthcare and Marksans Pharma Ltd. visit the college, making students placement-ready. The highest package students earn is in between 6 to 7 LPA. 50 percent of students get placed up to course completion. Regulatory Affair Manager roles are offered in these courses.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is well-developed, and there are many more facilities available for students. Unlimited Wi-Fi is available for students. The classrooms and labs are clean, and advanced technical things are available. A central library is available for each department. The hostels are near the college, and the food is available in the mess. Sporting events are organized and supported by the college. Medical facilities are available in the college. Overall, the college infrastructure is good.

reviews_list.review_title: Good college for education, environment, and campus.

review_content.Placements: Out of the batch, 20% of students placed through the college and self-reference. The package for students is not much more in the market, around 2 LPA. Through the college, B. Pharmacy placements are mostly in medical coding. Gibbs, Ajanta, and Wockhardt are the recruiting companies. About 50% of students got internships from the college.
review_content.Infrastructure: Good facilities and infrastructure are available for the course. Hostel life will be remembered for a lifetime. The hostel experience on this campus is one of the best for everyone. The canteen and mess are good enough, not much more. The campus has a ground, and annual sports are conducted by the college, which is interesting and fun.

reviews_list.review_title: Pros and cons of college.

review_content.Placements: Some students are placed in very well companies. I don't know much about placements as I have not spoke to many seniors. I have not given any interview. I am in the 3rd year but I believe if you have the capability, then you may get placed in a reputed company.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very well built and nicely maintained. I must say the campus is also very big. College is clean but the washrooms are bad and they do not have girls hostel facility. They have a boys common area and also girls common area available. There is a library too.

review_summary.college_name: GD Goenka University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.title: I am very glad to take admission in such a good university.

content.Placements: I don't know more about placement because last year I took admission here. But I heard from our seniors that placement depends on the student's results, and top companies participate here. All students get internships in special hospitals like Fortis and Medanta. It provides very good facilities by the university.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the building is well-built and of high-quality labs. Classrooms are digital. Library is very well furnished, and all books are available here. The quality of hostel is like a 5 star hostel, and medical facilities are also available. Food quality at hostel is very excellent.

individual_reviews.title: GD Goenka University is a good private college recognized by UGC, BCI, ICAR, PCI, and NAAC.

content.Placements: About 70% to 80% of students in our M.Pharm course get placed. The highest package is 18–20 LPA, the lowest is 3–7 LPA, and the average is 10–12 LPA. Recruiting companies include Medanta, Sun Pharma, Fortis, GRC Healthcare, and others. Around 80% of students get internships at Sun Pharma, like Regulatory Affairs and QA/QC.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, pharmaceutical labs, library, CIL labs, machine room, gym, cafeteria, swimming pool, football ground, archery room, badminton rooms, table tennis court, lawn tennis court, pool room, steam and spa rooms are all available. The quality of the food is amazing. There is centralized AC, a study room, a common room, a fridge, Wi-Fi, a smart TV, and hygienic washrooms in every room. Medical facilities are available 24/7.

individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely satisfied with it. Students must visit the university.

content.Placements: Around 70-80% of students get placements. The package offered is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Lenskart and Indira Gandhi Eye Hospital. 100% of students got internships from Indira Gandhi Eye Hospital, Dayal Eye Centre, and Ahooja Eye Hospital. In our course, mostly, roles are offered to all students.
content.Infrastructure: All the facilities are available for students like a peaceful library, Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms. The infrastructure is very attractive and unique from other universities. The hostel is similar to the classroom building. It has all facilities in the hostel like Wi-Fi, mess food, and all these things are very good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (BMRIT) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with my college.

content.Placements: The placement was really not good. You had to work on yourself for your placement. Only 10% of students got placed through the university. By teacher referrals, they also provided internships. Overall, the system or university was good if you could work hard on yourself.
content.Infrastructure: Faculty members were good. The library was well-maintained, and medical facilities were also good. Sports facilities were also good. You could participate in any co-curricular activities, as all were conducted by the university. The university environment was good for improving your personal growth.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) by NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute (DLI) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The facility is good, the environment, and facilities are good. All is good.

content.Placements: It is based on the person and no one on our campus is out for jobs. Top roles offered are like manager, HRO, and high- to low-paid jobs. IBM, Tata, TCS, and some others visit. Maybe 75% are placed in the course. I think. The higher package is 25 LPA and the lower package is 5 LPA, based on students.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, and library are good. Food is mostly North Indian, somewhat nice, and desserts are really tasty. All facilities are excellent. Wi-Fi provides personal access, and daily cleaning of rooms and washrooms, It provides good service in a hostel-like, home-environment.

admission_overview.description: Goenka University admission 2026 is based on the entrance exam. The university offers more than 20 courses including PhD courses under the schools, i.e., School of Engineering and Science, Law, Agricultural Science etc. GD Goenka admission is merit-based and accepts CUET scores for all UG and PG courses. GD Goenka University also accepts national-level entrance exams such as MAT/CAT/CMAT for admission to MBA courses. Furthermore, the institute has introduced the Center of Excellence Occupational Health, Safety, Fire and Environment. The university also accepts national-level exams such as the JEE Main/ GD Goenka Test for BTech programme.

admission_process.title: GD Goenka University Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: GD Goenka University admissionsare entrance-based for the majority of the programmes. Students who are interested in taking admission for at GD Goenka University can check the points mentioned below:
1. Application Process

The admission process starts with filling GD Goenka University application form. Interested candidates can visit the official website to apply for the course of their choice along with making the fee payment of INR 1,100 for all courses.
2. Selection Process
For MBA courses candidates need to clear CAT/ CMAT/ MAT/ CUET/GD Goenka Test and fulfil of latest eligibility, i.e., class 12. However, for the BTech programme, students need to clear JEE (Main).
3. Admission Confirmation

After completion of the selection rounds, the shortlisted candidates are called for verification of the documents. Aspirants need to payGD Goenka University course feeto confirm their seat in the university.

reviews.review_heading: I am very glad to take admission in such a good university.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the building is well-built and of high-quality labs. Classrooms are digital. Library is very well furnished, and all books are available here. The quality of hostel is like a 5 star hostel, and medical facilities are also available. Food quality at hostel is very excellent.

reviews.review_heading: GD Goenka University is a good private college recognized by UGC, BCI, ICAR, PCI, and NAAC.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, pharmaceutical labs, library, CIL labs, machine room, gym, cafeteria, swimming pool, football ground, archery room, badminton rooms, table tennis court, lawn tennis court, pool room, steam and spa rooms are all available. The quality of the food is amazing. There is centralized AC, a study room, a common room, a fridge, Wi-Fi, a smart TV, and hygienic washrooms in every room. Medical facilities are available 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with it. Students must visit the university.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available for students like a peaceful library, Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms. The infrastructure is very attractive and unique from other universities. The hostel is similar to the classroom building. It has all facilities in the hostel like Wi-Fi, mess food, and all these things are very good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with my college.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members were good. The library was well-maintained, and medical facilities were also good. Sports facilities were also good. You could participate in any co-curricular activities, as all were conducted by the university. The university environment was good for improving your personal growth.

reviews.review_heading: The facility is good, the environment, and facilities are good. All is good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, and library are good. Food is mostly North Indian, somewhat nice, and desserts are really tasty. All facilities are excellent. Wi-Fi provides personal access, and daily cleaning of rooms and washrooms, It provides good service in a hostel-like, home-environment.

reviews.review_heading: Good value for money and good environment.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good on our campus. There's a stationary, a cafe, a supermarket, and a canteen. Also, each and every classroom has AC and a projector. The hostel is good, with mess food being far better than many other hostel foods. Every hostel room also has a study room for students to study.

reviews.review_heading: Taking admission in GD should know all the information that is given in this article.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, libraries, and other areas are fully functional. We have good infrastructure. The food is amazing at the college. We have different options for food. The hostel people also have snacks and varieties to have so they don't feel sick.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to see your future, you can join GD Goenka.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of my course is the best, I feel, because in a proper way they have planned it, and from the second year, they are giving us the opportunity to try for an internship. The classroom is in the proper manner, and there are two labs in my university. If we talk about the hostel, they are also in a proper way.

reviews.review_heading: It is an average college for B.Tech or any other course. It is just like other private colleges.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure  is really good. There is a fully AC campus. Library, labs, and classrooms are well-maintained with Wi-Fi. There are refreshment areas like Domino's, Nescafe, CCD, Fuel Zap, Nirulas, and college canteens on the campus. Hostel is like a 4-star hotel with all facilities like fully AC, swimming pool, gym, shooting range, and many more. But hostel is quite expensive 2.5 lakhs for 4 sharing rooms and 1.5 lakhs for 8 sharing.

reviews.review_heading: Overall good college for the degree.
reviews.review_text: So the infrastructure of my college was so good; there were hostel facilities available for both girls and boys, and it was the best in the Delhi NCR. The mess was so good and had facilities for the gym and ground sports. Overall, it was very good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by United World Institute of Design, GD Goenka UniversityReviewed on 2 Jul 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty and management of this college.
reviews.review_text: UID has really good infrastructure and facilities for the students. All kinds of modern facilities were available for the students interactive learning. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, sports, etc. Facilities were given to the students. Mess and canteen food were good to eat. All the facilities are properly managed by the college management.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities include multiple sports fields, indoor sports facilities, the availability of coaching, auditoriums, amphitheaters, air-conditioned lecture halls and well-stocked libraries. The campus is huge and has many popular eateries and spots to hang out with your friends.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and average placements.
reviews.review_text: Each block of the university has its own air-conditioned spacious library with a good collection of books. The classrooms are also air conditioned. There are clean washrooms, good sports facilities, hygienic canteen and an overall green campus. The quality of food available in the mess as well as canteen is also satisfactory. The infrastructure and facilities that the university provides is worth the feels charge by them.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GD Goenka University.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure provided by our college are so good that we have a very big classroom with good Wi-Fi. Our hostel also has good food for students and no complaints have been reported by the students based on the quality of our food. Our hostel is good.

reviews.review_heading: Happy to have this college.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms in GD Goenka university are very much good and the infrastructure is very nice, all the classes have proper light, fans, AC rooms and all class have one or two projectors. Wi-Fi is available all the time and labs are also working and in good condition and students can access them any time whenever they want to use. There are two libraries in our college and every students can access both of them. And there is a huge collection of books. In hostel every rooms have AC, fridge, oven ...

individual_reviews.title: Review of Krupanidhi College of Pharmacy, Krupanidhi Group of Institutions.

content.Placements: The placement percentage for all colleges is different. As it is the best college in Karnataka, the placement percentage is 50-60%. Students who pass exams got internships. Many types of companies are available in the pharmacy course.
content.Infrastructure: It is the best college in Karnataka. Our college is near the railway station. In the college, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library are present. The hostel and PG facilities are available. The hostel food is average.
content.Faculty: Teachers are good in the college. They help students in studying and practicals. A semester exam is the best in the college. It is the greatest time in students' lives.

individual_reviews.title: I am very much happy that I was a student of this college.

content.Placements: In my college, there was a job conductor for placements. About 60% of students in my batch were placed during the placement festival. Most of the companies, like Cipla, Gel Tech, Bioplus, and Apollo Pharmacy Clinical Trials, along with many top and local companies, attended the placement festival. This allowed us to meet various companies for placement. Top roles like pharmacist, analyst, and R&D department were options for the students.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities provided by our college during my batch were very useful and helpful. The labs and classrooms were designed in a way that was beneficial for us. The library was filled with the books we needed. The hostel facilities were also very good, and the quality of the food available in the hostel and canteen was excellent in terms of hygiene. There was a sports committee that helped us stay fit.

individual_reviews.title: It's good, but placements aren't very available. Job fairs are organized.

content.Placements: There are no placements for our batch; they're scheduled for December, so we don't know about the packages. Last year, Hetero and Clinisol came for interviews. For internships, we have to find opportunities on our own. I went to Group Pharma in Malur for my internship. Roles available include pharmacist, production manager, and drug safety associate.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi isn't available. Classrooms are spacious, and the library is very good with all the necessary books. We can take only two books per card. The canteen is messy, and the food isn't that great but is acceptable. Medical facilities and sports activities are good. I'm a day scholar, so I don't know much about hostel life.

individual_reviews.title: It is a good college to study M.Pharm, but I am not satisfied because of placements.

content.Placements: Our college does not provide good placements for pharmacy students. Top recruiting companies visit our campus. Internships are provided after the completion of the course, and all students take part in them. All students are required to go to companies on their own.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is huge. A huge playground is available. Classrooms and labs are spacious. Sports facilities are good. A seminar hall is available. Our college has an indoor stadium to conduct programs. The hostel is good. The quality of the food in the mess is good. Medical facilities are available.

individual_reviews.title: The college needs to improve its placement record.

content.Placements: The college claims to provide good placements but there are none offered. The placement scenario here is not so good. After completing the course, students can search for jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Lab are good, clean, and well maintained. The canteen food is average but the hostel facility is good. Sports facilities are good for basketball. There is a lot of greenery at the center of the college. Classrooms are large with blackboard and projector screen.
content.Faculty: Professors are good and highly qualified. Notes are given to students on time. The passing percentage is 50 of 100. The course curriculum taught is relevant to make students work in industries and pharmacies. Regular tests are taken for practice.

paragraphs: IFTM University admissionis merit and entrance - based for admission to all the courses.The university offers various programmes at the UG, PG, Diploma and Doctorate levels. All these programmes are offered by eleven different schools ofIFTM University. The programmes are mainly in the field of Engineering, Business Management, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Arts, Sciences, Law, and Agricultural Sciences & Engineering.Candidates looking for admission to any courses can apply online by visiting the University's official website. Want to know more about the IFTM University admission process along with selection and eligibility criteria go through the following section:

IFTM University admission 2025for all the programmes are strictly based on merit scores in the last qualifying exam (Class 12 score for UG programme, graduation score for PG programme). However, for MPharm,BTech and MBA programme candidates are selected on the basis of a valid GPAT/CUET MAT/ CAT scores, respectively. Admission to the PhD programme is based on the candidate’s performance in the entrance test conducted by the University. IFTM courses along with the selection criteria and fee are tabulated below:

IFTM University admission processis merit and entrance-based. Candidates looking for admission to IFTM University must qualify for the respective entrance exams and other selection rounds including applying online on the official website of IFTM University. Checkout the following steps for a detailed IFTM University admission process:
Step 1: IFTM University Application Process

Candidates willing to take admission to any courses at IFTM University must submit an online application form along with a registration fee. The application will not be accepted by the institute without submitting the necessary documents.
Step 2: IFTM University Selection Round

As part of the selection process, candidates must qualify the university/ national-level entrance exam. Additionally, the university offers merit-based admission to some courses. After the selection rounds are over, the college releases a list of shortlisted candidates based on their eligibility fulfillment and scores in the selection rounds.
Step 3: Final Seat Allotment
IFTM University releases a merit list of selected students for final seat allotment.
Step 4: Admission Confirmation
The selected students in the IFTM University released list must pay course fees within the given dates to lock their seats.

faqs.question: Are there any government jobs that I can seek after completing a BA at IFTM University?
faqs.answer: Yes, BA graduates of IFTM University are eligible for a variety of government jobs. Mostly, BA graduates tend to lean towards administrative jobs in the government sector. Most of these jobs require aspirants to appear for competitive exams at the entry level. The below table highlights some government exams that BA graduates can take to secure good government jobs after graduating from IFTMU: BA Top Job Profiles Average Salary (in INR) IAS 30 lakh IPS 27 lakh IFS 27 lakh SSC officer 18 lakh Research Associate 4.6 lakh Social Defense Services 14 lakh Indian Airforce 8.5 lakh Bank PO 6.8 lakh Social Worker 3.4 lakh

faqs.question: What are the career prospects of pursuing a BA at IFTM University?
faqs.answer: Graduating with a BA degree from IFTM University leads to a variety of career paths. The career prospects majorly depend on the candidates' choice of specialisations. In general, a BA graduate can build a career in different sectors, such as management, media, tourism, education, etc. IFTMU BA students can also grab a job through the university's placements drive. They can also appear for government job exam that require a UG degree as the basic eligibility requirement. Further, they can pursue higher education with courses like MA/ MBA . Pursuing a Master's course after BA leads to better job prospects and career growth.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, IFTM UniversityReviewed on 19 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college is affordable and has good surroundings. The college has a joyful environment.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good. There is so much greenery around the campus. Every department has its own labs, smart classrooms, and an auditorium. We have a college gym, basketball court, football field, and a cricket ground. The hostel has its own mess.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by School of Bio Technology, IFTM UniversityReviewed on 11 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Campus life is the best as you enjoy every moment.
reviews.review_text: There is no proper instrumentation for the lab, although the classes are good. The best part of this college is the library; I have personally visited it many times and found all the books I needed available on campus. However, the food in the canteen is not good, as there are limited varieties, while the food in the hostels, like the mess, is better.

reviews.review_heading: Really good environment for studying.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure provide the whole campus Wi-Fi facility and labs are completely furnished with all equipment. Classrooms are neat and clear with proper sitting arrangements. I am not a hostel student so I don't know about that part of college.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by School of Computer Science and Applications, IFTM UniversityReviewed on 1 Feb 2025)
reviews.review_heading: My college: My small world.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is well-constructed. The college campus is very beautiful. Classrooms are well-maintained. Benches, boards, and everything is good. There is a big library on our college campus. Our hostel is well-maintained. They provide a room with 1 bed, table, chair, and cupboard. They provide us with four meals a day. The mess food is quite well. The medical and sports facilities are also available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by School of Computer Science and Applications, IFTM UniversityReviewed on 31 Dec 2024)
reviews.review_heading: My university, my experience.
reviews.review_text: The facility infrastructure is very good. There is a library, a computer lab in the department, and free Wi-Fi for everyone. The quality of the hostel is pretty good, and the quality of the food is good too. There are medical facilities available 24/7, and many sports are offered.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by School of Social Sciences, IFTM UniversityReviewed on 27 Dec 2024)
reviews.review_heading: My honest review: I am satisfied with the value for money; the placements of the university are avg,
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good; Wi-Fi is available on the entire campus. Classrooms are big, and daily cleaning services are also provided by the university. Hostels are average, and food is normal in the hostel mess, but in the canteen, you can get better food. Sports facilities are also good in the university; there is one gymnasium hall, and you can get any sports-related items.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by School of Business Management, IFTM UniversityReviewed on 1 Nov 2024)
reviews.review_heading: They do not place all the students.

faqs.answer: A:    Madras Medical College, Chennai requires NEET scores for admission to the MBBS program. Therefore, it is mandatory for candidates to qualify for the NEET exam to be eligible for admission to the MBBS programme at Madras Medical College.
faqs.question: Can I join Madras Medical College, Chennai without NEET?

faqs.answer: A:    A significant number of applicants compete for a limited number of seats in government medical colleges under the All India quota based on NEET exam, making admission extremely competitive.For General AI category, the cutoffs are substantially higher than the cutoff for other All India quota seats. A considerably higher score—often in the range of 650–700 or more out of 720—is typically needed to be eligible for a place in a government medical college through the All India quota.A candidate who scores only 2–4 marks above the cutoff is likely to enter a highly competitive zone where their prospects of getting an All India quota seat are unpredictable and dependent on a number of variables, including the distribution of their overall score and the number of seats available.The number of candidates taking the NEET exam has a direct effect on the cut-off as well. A big candidate pool raises the level of competition and could result in higher cutoffs. The cut-off scores are impacted by the number of seats available in medical colleges.

reviews.review_heading: Best for being a successful doctor.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in our course include speed Wi-Fi and fully equipped labs, meaning everything is present. Fully air-conditioned classrooms with 30 students in each classroom. The hostel facility is very good. Food quality is very good, and food is given in unlimited quantities. Sports and games are also available.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty members and placements, etc.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are outdated, and campus is spread over 10 acres. Wi-Fi, classroom, labs, and a well-stocked library are available on campus. Quality of food is good, and separate hostels are available for girls and boys. Outdoor and indoor games also occurred on campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is a decent college with good learning, but it needs improvement in facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our department has classrooms, labs, and the library. Labs are okay and not very modern, but they are useful for study. Wi-Fi is there, but it is sometimes slow or does not work properly. The library has many books, but they are all a little old. Hostel facility is available. Rooms are okay, not very clean, but livable.

reviews.review_heading: I like the appreciation of extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: There will be inter-college sports meet and inter-college cultural meet, and they will also allow you for intra-college completion. There is sports coordinator here who will genuinely guide you and appreciate you. Every year, there will be sports GDC events in which all batches from final year to first year will participate and medals and an honor certificate will be given to all those winners on Republic Day. There will be interesting college and cultural events.

reviews.review_heading: Girls-boys ratio is nearly 7:3. Hostel is available for both girls and boys.
reviews.review_text: Actually, every book that is needed for the course is plenty in the library including journals, magazines, and so on. Classes will be held only by the projector technique. Sometimes it will be with visual, audio, and audio-visual aids. Mostly there is no extra care in sports but competitions will be held.

reviews.review_heading: I'm dissatisfied with infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The washrooms and toilets are in very bad condition. They are very hygienic and no proper supply of water in taps. Classrooms and labs are average. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is not so good. Very limited sports facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with faculty members, placements, etc.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are one of the oldest and most prestigious government medical colleges. Campus is well organised and located in Chennai near Park Town. Wi-Fi, labs, classroom, and well-stocked library are available on campus. Quality of food is hygienic. Hostels for girls and boys are separate.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with our college and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are a good mix of historical and modern era. It is the oldest college in India. On campus, we have Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms. Library is well stocked with thousands of books. Quality of the food is average, and hostels are available near main campus. Hostels  are separate for boys and girls.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement with decent infrastructure, but food average.
reviews.review_text: Our pharmacy department has a good lab and all the equipment also. Classrooms have fans, lights, and a projector, which sometimes do not work. Wi-Fi is available, but mostly slow. The library is big and has books, but not all of them are new ones. The hostel is of an okay type, and the room is a little small. Mess food is not so tasty, but it's okay to eat. The canteen has limited items. A medical facility is there, but sometimes the doctor is not available. The sports ground is also there, but ...

reviews.review_heading: It is really a good college for the medical field.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Our department has all the required equipment in labs for activities. The library is available in the college for reference books. Limited sports facilities are present. Basic medical facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the curriculum and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Overall, facilities available for our department are very nice. Classrooms and labs are well-managed and modified with all the requirements. Hostel rooms are comfortable and clean. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is hygienic. Laboratories are available for doing experiments oriented to pharmacology and clinical pharmacology. Laboratories are also well-developed here. There is a versatile canteen area that provides food for everyone who comes there.

reviews.review_text: The campus is surrounded by greenery everywhere, which gives fresh air and proper ventilation in classrooms. It has a vast collection of books in the well-stocked library. reviews.review_text: The campus is surrounded by greenery everywhere which gives fresh air and proper ventilation in classrooms. It has a vast collection of books in the well-stocked library. The quality of food is acceptable. Multiple sports and medical facilities are available.

reviews.review_text: It is mandatory to wear coats and uniforms on campus days. Even during training, it is necessary to wear white coats and carry stethoscopes. To provide proper training on live cases, 1,300 beds are available to offer hands-on experience with real-time cases.

reviews.review_heading: It has a big campus but an average faculty. No placements in Agriculture, and limited student life.
reviews.review_text: I am studying B.Sc.(Hons.) in Agriculture at IES University, Bhopal. The infrastructure for our course is decent. Classrooms are spacious with projectors, and the seating is comfortable enough. The library is big with a fair collection of books and journals, though agriculture-specific material could be improved. Wi-Fi is available across the campus, but sometimes, the speed is slow. Labs and experiential farms are provided for agriculture students, which help in practical learning. However, the...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty and placement. To be honest our college is the best.
reviews.review_text: Hostel life is much better than I had imagined. Classrooms and library are also good and peaceful even the sports faculty and facilities are provided by the college on the next level. Every month sports events are organized by the university and other teams.

reviews.review_heading: The college has helpful and good faculty members, placements are average, and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is excellent. There is another building offered for our department no other one can enter in our department from another department. The lab conditions are good. Many systems are available in our lab to practice our problem and improve our coding skills. The classroom facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Good, but can be better. More & more involvement from the media industry should be brought to table.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. We have access to our studios and libraries, and the editing rooms are available for us. The students are allowed to use the digital equipment available in college, and we are allowed to cover events and do photography and videography.

reviews.review_heading: Good or bad things about the college, but this is actually a good college & you can enjoy your life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not available. The quality of labs is low. My classroom in college is good, like average. The college library is excellent. It has a quiet and relaxing feel for studying. The hostel is not good. I stayed in the college hostel for only one year. The environment is fully green. The facilities for sports and games are crowded.

reviews.review_heading: If you have talent then you should be away from this college otherwise most welcome .
reviews.review_text: Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, and a library are available. The facilities provided in the hostel are good; they provide a bed, study table, and locker, but the quality of food in the mess is the worst. In my opinion, consider a paying guest accommodation. Canteen and sports facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with this college; the admission and office work are very bad.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good; there are many facilities available in our university such as a library, all labs, and some smart classes, but not all classes are smart. The hostel facilities are good; they are well-maintained and always neat and clean. The mess in the university is not good because the food is not well-prepared for students.

reviews.review_heading: In IES university, there is a very big issue with the fee structure.
reviews.review_text: Faculty is very good in the civil engineering department. Infrastructure like the classroom is average, the library and labs are quite good, and wi-fi is not available for students. Mobile phones are restricted on college campuses. Drinking water is not drinkable and not available 24*7.

reviews.review_heading: It’s my humble request to students not to take admission in this college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good; classrooms are average, but no labs or library services are provided to students. Canteen food is good. Medical facilities are also available to the students, but no sports or games are available to the students. Games are only allowed if one takes part in any tournament.

reviews.review_heading: This is an honest review of the B.Sc. B.Ed. dual degree program from a girl's perspective.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are very good, all equipped as smart classes with projectors, smart boards, and traditional chalkboards. LAN Wi-Fi is available in all departments throughout the college. The Wi-Fi speed is slightly low but sufficient for studying from YouTube. The library and labs are not up to par. The library is small and sometimes runs out of stock of curriculum books. Hostels are quite good with all amenities available at an affordable rate; there are three hostels in total, two for boys and one ...

reviews.review_heading: Integrated B.Sc. and B.Ed. Dual Degree Course Review.
reviews.review_text: All the labs are well-furnished and equipped with the latest equipment. The Computer Science department lab is the best lab on campus. It has been made in collaboration with TCS ION Digital. It is said to be one of the best labs among Bhopal city's colleges. The library is decent, with only curriculum books present there. Seating places for those who want to sit and study are also available, but the library is not big enough to handle all the crowd. Classrooms are new with modern furniture; ther...

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college that provides good placements, infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our department are good. All the facilities are provided in our course such as free internet for studying, a library, classrooms, labs, and very good quality hostels. It has a ground to play games.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IES University.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides us with all facilities. Our college has more than 5 buildings, 2 canteens, 2 libraries, many computer labs, mechanical lab, civil lab, accounting sector, etc. Our college provides specific branches like pharmacy, diploma, hotel management, B.Tech in engineering, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has friendly teachers.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good infrastructure and facilities. A library is available. Sports facilities are available. Living spaces are clean. Wi-Fi is available. The hostel is clean. A canteen is available. It is an excellent campus in Bhopal. Hostel facilities are excellent. All classrooms are equipped with smart boards, which makes learning more interactive and engaging. They are essential for conducting experiments and practical work.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for engineering students but not for management and other fields.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is excellent. We have clean classrooms and labs as well as libraries. Canteen food is also healthy and it gives many varieties of fast food. They have two basketball courts, a football ground on the campus, separate department buildings, etc.

placements.overview:
JIS University, located in Kolkata was established through the JIS University Act 2014, which came into force in 2015. The university encourages entrepreneurship & skill development among the students to promote employability & self-employment. JIS University Kolkata is approved by UGC, AICTE, NCTE, PCI, & the Bar Council of India. It is a private university & is accredited by NAAC. Further, JIS University in Kolkata is recognised as a Scientific & Industrial Research Organisation by the Department of Scientific & Industrial Research, Government of India, & is a member of AIU & UNAI. The university has strategic tie-ups with leading companies such as the Asian Institute of Technology, Assocham Institute, Nasscom, etc.

JIS University popular programmes include BTech and MBA. The university offers various programmes at UG, PG, and other levels. The college offers degree courses in full-time mode across several specialisations such as Engineering, Computer Application, Hotel Administration, Agriculture, etc. The duration of these programmes ranges from 2 to 4 years.

The JIS University Kolkata admission 2025 is offered in online mode and is merit and entrance-based. To get online admission to JISU, candidates must check the official website of the university. The university offers a wide range of programmes at UG and PG levels under various departments and across several specialistions.
