reviews.review_heading: Review of my great JIS University.
reviews.review_text: JIS University has modern facilities and well-structured infrastructure to support quality education and the holistic development of students. The hostel facilities are comfortable, with clean rooms, adequate water supply, and common areas for students. The mess and canteen offer a variety of food options maintaining both quality and hygiene. Medical facilities are available within the campus, ensuring timely healthcare support for students.

reviews.review_heading: The best law university in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Every facility is good. The students get free Wi-Fi access throughout the university. The books are available properly. The classrooms are enough according to the student ratio. The canteen and hostel facilities should be improved.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JIS University.
reviews.review_text: There are particular classrooms for each section and department, and Wi-Fi is also available. A library is also available. If you want to read a book, then go to the library and sit silently. 2 time the price and twice the tiffin is available there. In the morning, they give tiffin, and also in the evening.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JIS University.
reviews.review_text: Our college has its own Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a separate library for separate courses. Wi-Fi is available for faculty and students also. There are separate lifts for teachers and students. At first the hostel of JIS is not so good but now the hostel of JIS University is very good. There is also a separate Wi-Fi system in all the rooms. But JIS University does not have its own playground.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, great placement assistance, qualified faculty, best infrastructure, and superb college.
reviews.review_text: One of the best infrastructures in eastern India. Computer Lab with all Apple PC, and 6 more labs with high-end PCs (Intel I5). Wi-Fi throughout campus (Speed 200 Kbps - 1.2 Mbps). There are more than 100 routers on the 10th floor. 3 gallery style AC classrooms and others are non AC. So good that Tollywood Mega Star JEETs film RAVAN was filmed, and also other small web series and podcasts were done. Library is good, and books are available. Hostel and Food are average.

reviews.review_heading: A good place to learn not only for a degree but also about life.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure with AC classrooms and a lab, multiple labs, free Wi-Fi, a big playground with football bars, cricket pitch, volleyball court, an indoor table tennis deck, a badminton court, and a cultural room with instruments for the cultural enthusiasts.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college, you can take admission.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. In every semester, you have some interesting subjects, and also NPTEL subjects are included in syllabus, where you have to give the NPTEL exams to clear the semester. I am not a hostel girl. I do my college from my house. So I don't have so much information about our college hostel. I know that it is decent and food is also good at canteen though I have never tasted it.

reviews.review_heading: The college is so good, and facilities are helpful. The selection rate is better than others.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is always available in college. The hostel is good, but it's off campus. The food is good for health. In college, so many events and sports are conducted by the college. A district-level playing chance is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Our college environment is very student-friendly.
reviews.review_text: There are high-tech labs and classrooms with a projector. Many professors do not use digital screens or a projector. The food quality of the mess is average, and it has many options.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life and beautiful vibe.
reviews.review_text: The quality of the labs is good. The library is good, but the classes are not that good.   Some classes have AC, but the maximum classes have a fan, and not all students can sit on chairs that are available on some days. All floors are cleaned all the time, and all types of sports events are included.

reviews.review_heading: It is regrettable to take admission in JIS University.
reviews.review_text: It claims that it has Wi-Fi and classrooms. It will not provide students with Wi-Fi in reality. But the hostel is okay to stay in, and seniors are also friendly to enjoy college life. JIS is the best option, but not for a career.

reviews.review_heading: JIS University is very good for your future. Placement records are great.

Applicants can apply for the course of their choice online on the university's official website. The university offers many courses under UG, PG, and doctoral levels under various streams, such as Medical, Computer Application, and others. Students need to provide valid scores obtained in the national-level entrance exam in addition to appearing for the counselling process (if applicable).  All the information related to the courses, eligibility, and other admission-related information forVinayaka Mission's Research Foundationcan be found in the following article.

Vinayaka Mission's Research Foundationadmission to all the courses is merit and entrance-based. The college offers various UG, PG, diploma and PhD courses. Candidates seeking admission to Vinayaka Missions University for any courses are required to fulfil the eligibility criteria and appear for the selection process accepted by the college. The basic eligibility for UG is to pass Class 12 from a recognised board and pass UG and PG degrees for admission to PG and PhD courses, respectively. The selection criteria may vary depending on the specialisation selected by the students. For certain specialisations, students may get selected based on merit in the last qualifying exam, however, entrance may be needed for other specialisations. Applicants looking forward to admission to various programmes at Vinayaka Missions University must fill up the admission form online by visiting the official website of the college. Application forms cannot be submitted without uploading the required documents.
Step 2: Selection Round

According to the selection criteria, the applicants must have passed Class 12 for admission to UG and a graduation degree for admission to PG. Additionally, for all the courses, applicants must appear for the entrance exam accepted by the university and score well. The university releases the shortlisted candidates’ list for all the courses based on their scores in entrance exams. Students can either provide valid scores obtained in any of the accepted tests, such as JEE Main, CLAT, CUET, etc., or appear for the university-level test (if there is one for the desired course).
Step 3: Final Seat Confirmation

The university releases a merit list of the selected applicants for all courses for the final seat allotment. Students need to participate in the counselling process to get a seat in most of the offered courses.
Step 4: Admission Confirmation
The selected applicants must make a fee payment within the given deadline to secure their seats.

review_content.Placements: They are doing their best to get students placed in companies. review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is pretty good. Labs, buildings, and cafés are in good condition. The whole campus is very big with a lot of green parks and gardens. review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite nice. Classrooms and corridors are well-maintained and clean all the time. Wi-Fi is available all around the campus. review_summary.college_name: SGT University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) with Research in Radio-Imaging Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Everything is good in our college.

content.Placements: I don't know about that. Currently, I'm in my 1st semester, but I heard that all things are good in this university. The top roles in our course are radiology technicians. We can perform X-ray, CT scan, MRI, fluoroscopy, and so much more. We can also be teachers after doing an M.Sc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is really good, but Wi-Fi doesn't work in some places. However, the Wi-Fi network is good in the library and labs. There's also a hospital to perform or teach practical things to students so they can become good doctors. Placements are provided mainly in good hospitals.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Clinical Psychology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: SGT University review in my opinion.

content.Placements: Above 75% in 10th and 12th. I actually have no idea about the package offered as of now. Many students have done internships in hospitals or Mental Health Centres, where theoretical and practical knowledge increases. However, they do give LOR late.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is nice. There are food courts. Hostels have good rooms. They have a maximum of 4-B.Ed sharing with box beds and almirahs. Also, some food courts deliver at the hostel gate. Facilities are good, food is also good (I mean, what more can you expect from a hostel). But, the feels, in my opinion, is a lot.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: SGT gives you wings and good friends.

content.Placements: They are doing their best to get students placed in companies. Even though the packages are not very good, I assume around 70 percent of students in my batch have been placed through campus placements. The highest package is around 40 LPA. I don’t know about the lowest, but the average package is 2.5 LPA. Top companies are Wipro, Infosys, and some ed-tech companies like Unacademy. Around 80 percent of students are currently doing internships, either from campus or off-campus, in companies like Honda and Xiaomi.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is pretty good. Labs, buildings, and cafés are in good condition. The whole campus is very big with a lot of green parks and gardens. Hostels have lifts and provide four-time meals with specific timings. Hostels also have a gym, table tennis, and some board games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Forensic Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall, I have a good experience.

content.Placements: Placements for my course are decent and improving each year. Around 60–70 percent of my seniors get placed via campus drives. The highest package offered is 8–9 LPA, the average package is around 3–4 LPA, and the lowest is between 2–2.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite nice. Classrooms and corridors are well-maintained and clean all the time. Wi-Fi is available all around the campus. Each block has its own library. It is quite peaceful place to spend study time. The hostels have strict security and maintain privacy. All other facilities are adequate.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) with Research in Forensic Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Take admission in SGTU, Gurgaon.

content.Placements: The placements are also good with top ranking students being placed just after Bachelors with good packages. We now have more than 15 top tier companies and we are eligible for the Big Four companies. Internships and training opportunities are available. Bachelors in Forensic is very vast, we can pursue our career in any subfield we like.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good and they provide buses for day scholars. Wi-Fi is provided but jammers are sometimes present. Hostels are clean, and food is edible. The library is well facilitated. There is even a book fair for you to buy books. Library has most of the books available but if you want to buy any of them, we have a supplier who comes every year. You can also participate in events of other faculty members which gives you a chance to experience their student life for a day.

SGT University admissions start with registration on the official website of the university. Candidates have to fulfil both selection and eligibility requirements for admission. Below are the steps to get a seat in SGT University:
STEP 1: SGT University Application Process 2025

The mode of application is online as well as offline. Candidates can collect the application form from the campus or register with personal, academic and other details on the university website. Aspirants must enclose the application form with the specified documents.
STEP 2: Selection

SGT University selects candidates for most of the UG courses based onCUETscores. The university acceptsCUET-PGfor PG courses such as MBA, MSc, MPharm, etc. Besides, candidates must also fulfil the eligibility criteria to apply for admission. The university might conduct a personal interview round for some of the courses.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation

Candidates taking admission via CUET are allotted seats through the counselling process. Once the selection process is over, candidates need to pay the course fee to confirm their admission in the university.

hostel.description: The University has separate hostels for girls and boys with round the clock security arrangements, each hostels has separate dining rooms, recreation rooms and study rooms. The hostel rooms are very well furnished with beds, study tables, chairs and cupboards and equipped with ceiling fans and lights. Special facilities for air conditioners to be used on extra payment basis shall also be provided. Hostel accommodation shall be given for once a year instead one year commencing from the start of the academic year. All students enrolled with the university as regular students except ex-students are entitled to apply and be considered for hostel accommodation.CCTV surveillance in hostel areas. Dedicated wardens for each hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is good in our college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really good, but Wi-Fi doesn't work in some places. However, the Wi-Fi network is good in the library and labs. There's also a hospital to perform or teach practical things to students so they can become good doctors. Placements are provided mainly in good hospitals.

reviews.review_heading: SGT University review in my opinion.
reviews.review_text: The campus is nice. There are food courts. Hostels have good rooms. They have a maximum of 4-B.Ed sharing with box beds and almirahs. Also, some food courts deliver at the hostel gate. Facilities are good, food is also good (I mean, what more can you expect from a hostel). But, the feels, in my opinion, is a lot.

reviews.review_heading: SGT gives you wings and good friends.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty good. Labs, buildings, and cafés are in good condition. The whole campus is very big with a lot of green parks and gardens. Hostels have lifts and provide four-time meals with specific timings. Hostels also have a gym, table tennis, and some board games.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I have a good experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite nice. Classrooms and corridors are well-maintained and clean all the time. Wi-Fi is available all around the campus. Each block has its own library. It is quite peaceful place to spend study time. The hostels have strict security and maintain privacy. All other facilities are adequate.

reviews.review_heading: Take admission in SGTU, Gurgaon.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good and they provide buses for day scholars. Wi-Fi is provided but jammers are sometimes present. Hostels are clean, and food is edible. The library is well facilitated. There is even a book fair for you to buy books. Library has most of the books available but if you want to buy any of them, we have a supplier who comes every year. You can also participate in events of other faculty members which gives you a chance to experience their student life for a day...

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really good. There is a centralized AC; also, the hostel has AC. Their labs, classrooms, and library are of first-class quality. The food at the mess is A1, and the sports facility is also good. A medical facility is obviously provided as they offer medical courses and have a hospital too.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with college and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very nice with AC, Wi-Fi, a library, and good classrooms. I have not opted for a hostel, but it is also good, as I have seen it. When I took part in fests, I have seen the hostel and many student reviews are good about that. The food quality is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Self and overall development.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. Sometimes the wardens get rude and don't inform things on time, but otherwise they are completely okay. The food is good; different items are made for variety and are eatable. Medical facilities are fully provided as the college has a hospital.

reviews.review_heading: University boasts a team of highly experienced and supportive faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Campus facilities are impressive. The library is digital, but students also have the option to visit and study there in person. There is free Wi-Fi throughout the campus. Hostel food is considered better than what is typically found in other colleges, and the medical facilities stand out as the university has its own hospital. In addition, there is a strong emphasis on sports and extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: The university faculty is highly experienced and helpful.
reviews.review_text: The university library is digital, and you can also go to the library. Free Wi-Fi is available. The food in the hostel is very nice compared to other colleges. The medical facilities are very good; the university has its hospital. Also, the university focuses on sports.

reviews.review_heading: The college organizes a great Holi fest, and has really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-notch. Washrooms are so clean, and they have pads in them. We have Wi-Fi, personal labs, and a library. Hostels are also good. The quality of food is very nice, and we get fresh fruits and homely food. We have to pay Rs. 20 as a token of money if we want to see a doctor in the hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and facilities.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there are full facilities of strong high-speed Wi-Fi and all subjects like Agronomy, Entomology, Horticulture, Seed, and Soil labs. In our college, all the classrooms have working ACs, and the library has books of all authors and subjects.

reviews.review_heading: Overall a decent college if you have money.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are fully air-conditioned with projectors. Labs are equipped decently, especially anatomy and pathology. Wi-Fi is available, but the speed can be slow sometimes. The library is spacious and quiet with good study material. Hostels are average with both AC and non-AC options. Washrooms are attached, and cleanliness is okay. The mess food is repetitive and not very tasty, but edible. Medical services are available on campus 24/7. There's a basketball court and a gym, though not very well...

reviews.review_heading: The college is full of memories.
reviews.review_text: There is a great infrastructure in our college. There are practical labs for research work. Unlimited Wi-Fi is available for students. There are classrooms with smart classes for presentations. The library has all books for the welfare of students.

reviews.review_heading: "The faculty is amazing in this college. It has great opportunities for students". .
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility was very good as there were One sharing, two sharing, three sharing and four sharing rooms with very good balcony view and attached washrooms. The meal quality was very good in all aspects regarding taste, quality, etc. The registration process for hostel and affordability was so simple as you have to select the room you want and then book the room according to your comfort and give 2 photos with phones number.

college_info.college_name: SGT University Scholarship Details

paragraphs: SGT University offers scholarships to meritorious students in the form of fee concessions at the time of admission and in subsequent years. Candidates of UG (except for the Faculties of Medicine & Health Sciences, Dental Sciences, Indian Medical System) and PG courses are eligible for 20% to 100% fee concession based on their merit scores. Apart from this, SGT University offers additional scholarship benefits to students under specific categories.
DFP-Banner
SGT University offers merit-based scholarships to the students of UG and PG courses. The details of all the scholarships offered to the deserving students are given below:

The scholarships will be admissible to students of UG courses (except for the courses offered under the Faculties of Medicine & Health Sciences, Indian Medical System, and Dental Sciences) on a merit basis. Scholarships for the students of lateral entry will also be awarded as per the same criteria.

Criteria: The percentage for the scholarships will be calculated under PCB/M/CS and English as compulsory subjects or the best of four subjects with English as one of the compulsory subjects. Subsidiary subjects like Drawing, Music, and Physical Education will not be considered for calculating the percentage. The criteria for these scholarships are mentioned in the below table:
Scholarship Eligibility
Scholarship Amount (in %) for PG candidates
90% and above
75% and above but less than 90%
60% and above but less than 75%

The scholarship will be given to the courses offered under the Faculties of Commerce & Management, Behavioural Sciences, Nursing (including NPCC), Physiotherapy, Allied Health Sciences, Mass Communication & Media Technology, Education, Law, Fashion & Design, Agricultural Sciences, and Science. Candidates pursuing MSc (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Environmental Science), Medicine & Health Sciences, and SGT College of Pharmacy will not be considered for these scholarships.
Criteria: Merit in the last qualifying examination i.e. the UG degree will be considered for the award of scholarship. The criteria for these scholarships are mentioned in the below table:
Scholarship Eligibility
Scholarship Amount (in %) for PG candidates
90% and above
75% and above but less than 90%
60% and above but less than 75%
Alumni students with 50% to 60%

Apart from merit-based scholarships, students can also avail of SGT University scholarships under other categories like Defence and girl students. Mentioned below are the category-wise scholarships offered at the university:
1. Girl Students:
-Up to 5% concession on tuition fee for girl students of non-medical courses is awarded by the university
-Students of MBBS, BDS, BAMS, MD, MS, MDS, BASLP, Professional Diploma in Clinical Psychology, PhD., MPhil, D.Ed. Spl. Edn., and B. Ed. Spl. Edn. will not be considered for this concession.
2. Siblings of students:
-Siblings of university students are eligible for a fee concession of 35% per year
-Awarded to studnets of all UG and PG courses except Medical, Dental, Nursing, Pharmacy and Ayurveda
3. Relatives of the university employees:
-Only the candidates related to university employees by blood (son/ daughter) or husband/ wife are considered
-Students of BSc Nursing (Post Basic) are eligible for 25% tuition fee concession every year
-For all other courses (except Medical, Dental, Nursing, Pharmacy, and Ayurveda), fee concession of 35% is awarded
4. Defence Category:
-Boy/ girl students whose parents are retired or serving in Defence (Army/ Navy/ Air Force/ Para Military Forces)
Candidates applying for scholarships under this category, need to submit several documents. Documents required in case of both serving and retired Defence personnel are listed below:
(i) Dependent’s card issued to the servicemen/ certificate issued by the Unit Head/ C.O. of the servicemen
(ii) Discharge certificate of the servicemen (applicable under retired Defence personnel category)
(iii) ID card of the servicemen/ ex-servicemen (whichever is applicable)
(iv) ID/Aadhaar card of the student
4. Principal’s reference
Boy/ girl students of various courses are admissible for 5% fee concession on the reference of the principal

SGT University offers up to 25% scholarship in subsequent years in the form of tuition fee concession based on the student's performance in the semester/ annual examinations (as the case may be). The award of scholarships to students will be continued after the third semester based on the criteria mentioned below:
75% or above aggregate in the previous year's final examination
80% or more attendance in all subjects of the course including practical (wherever applicable)
Cleared all the dues and paid the whole course fee for the particular semester/year
No involvement in any act of indiscipline, ragging, eve teasing, etc.
Not availing any other scholarship from any other Govt./ Govt. organisation/ Institute
Submitted the Scholar Project in consultation with their respective Dean/Faculty member

admission_process.title: Glocal University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Glocal University admission 2025are both merit and entrance-based. The University offers around 80 courses at UG, PG, diploma, advance diploma and doctoral level under 14 different schools in the field of Management, Law, Engineering, Agriculture, Pharmacy, Arts, Commerce and many more. All the courses offered by the University are in full-time mode. Candidates are required to follow the specified admission process to get a chance at securing a seat in their desired programme.Glocal Universityadmission process for the session 2025-26 is ongoing.

Glocal University offers admission to UG and PG courses based on merit or national or state-level entrance exam scores. The university offers full-time courses for interested candidates. There are more than 80 courses incluing specialisations for candidates to choose from. Candidates can learn more about the university through the highlights table given below:

Admission to Glocal University's undergraduate and graduate programmes is determined by merit and results on the entrance exam for different course. Additionally, Glocal University administers entrance exams for MBA, LLM, and other course admissions. Class 12 is the minimum requirement for UG courses, whereas graduation is necessary to apply for PG programs.

The Glocal University entrance exam is used to select students for well-known programs like MBA and LLM. The eligibility and selection criteria for a few of theGlocal University coursesare listed in the table below:

The whole cost of attending Glocal University includes several parts, including tuition, a caution deposit, test fees, and more. Tuition is paid annually, while other fee components, such as the caution deposit, are paid just once. Candidates are required to pay theGlocal University feethrough the means that have been made available. Check out the fee table given below:
Note:This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

The admissions procedure at Glocal University consists of several steps. Applicants must first submit an application for the course of their choice. The university's official website offers the application form online. Admission to courses at Glocal University is determined by entrance and merit. The detailed admissions procedure for Glocal University is described below:
Step 1: Glocal University Application Process 2025

Candidates fulfilling the eligibility requirements can apply online for Glocal University admission. As per the information collected, the application fee must be paid to register for a course. Candidates need to fill out the form and upload the specified documents to complete the application process.
Step 2: Selection Process

Glocal University shortlists candidates for most of the courses based on the merit of the candidate; they are required to appear for entrance exams for a few courses. The university considers academic merit for admission to courses like MA, PG Diploma, etc. The first level of selection after the application process will be either based on the entrance exam or academic merit.
Step 3: Document Verification and Fee Payment

Glocal University announces the names of the shortlisted candidates on a merit list following the conclusion of the selection rounds. These applicants are also contacted for document verification and counseling. To guarantee their spot at the university, applicants must pay the Glocal University fee.

faqs.question: What is the fee for BSc at Glocal University?
faqs.answer: Glocal University offers BSc and BSc (Hons) in nine and three specialisations, respectively. All the programmes are offered in a full-time mode for a course duration of three to four years. The total tuition fee for the BSc course ranges from INR 1.77 Lacs to INR 3.20 lakh. For admission to the BSc programme, the final selection for all these programmes is based on meeting the minimum eligibility criteria. The minimum eligibility criteria is that the candidate must have passed Class 12 from a recognised board.

faqs.question: What is the fee for BAMS at Glocal University?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for the BAMS course offered by Glocal School of Ayurvedic Medical Sciences is INR 15 lakh. The duration of the programme is 4.5 years including a one-year internship programme. The qualification needed for the BAMS programme is a pass in an intermediate programme with Chemistry, Biology, Physics, and Sanskrit. The candidate must pass Class 12 from a recognised board. The minimum age limit is 17 years.

college_info.intro:
ADTU has multiple course options for students from different streams and fields. Assam Down Town University Panikhaiti Guwahati courses include popular Master of Business Administration (MBA) and Bachelor of Technology (BTech) programmes. UG and PG courses are offered at ADTU Guwahati. In UG programmes, other courses include BSc, BDes, BBA, etc., while PG options are MSc, MSW, MPharma, etc.

placements.overview:
Assam Down Town University (ADTU) was established in 2010 by the down town Charity Trust. ADTU has more than 4000 students and over 300 faculty. Down Town University Guwahati courses are given in the disciplines in Engineering, Allied Health Science, Management, Nursing, and Pharmacy. Assam Down Town University (ADTU) is home to both Indian and international students. ADTU Guwahati has been accredited by NAAC with an 'A+' grade.

Down Town University in Guwahati provides students with a vast amount of exposure in several forms- modern teaching methods, global links for research, student exchange and knowledge sharing, world-class infrastructure, placement, diversity of students, and industry-institute interaction. ADTU has collaborated with Rotary Club of Guwahati, North East Cancer Hospital and Research Institute, Indian Institute of Technology, and many more in the field of science.

ADTU has multiple course options for students from different streams and fields. Assam Down Town University Panikhaiti Guwahati courses include popular Master of Business Administration (MBA) and Bachelor of Technology (BTech) programmes. UG and PG courses are offered at ADTU Guwahati. In UG programmes, other courses include BSc, BDes, BBA, etc., while PG options are MSc, MSW, MPharma, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Good faculty, helpful teachers. Average placement, but can achieve higher, with good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: I am in B.Tech CSE, I had 62 percent in my 12th and chose ADTU to study CSE with a specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. The one campus placement offers are not that good, but not bad either. If you maintain a good GPA, then the chances of getting a good placement are higher, ranging from 3.3 LPA to 11 LPA sometimes.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good in every aspect. ADTU has Wi-Fi connection all around the campus and per classroom, smart boards and projectors per class, a library is big, has a gym, swimming pool, badminton court, football ground, and everything. The hostel facility is good too, they have a geyser, washing machines, and a dryer. You can get an AC facility in the hostel.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) with IBM - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Very good college, satisfied with the infrastructure and campus out there.

review_content.Placements: Placement cell is good, it helps the students in placement time, and helps them to secure a good position in a company with a very decent average package. Students feel very motivated with the help of the placement cell and faculty. They give their best.
review_content.Infrastructure: The university is situated in a very good location with greenery and natural beauty everywhere with good views and cafes in each block and also good and hygienic food in the canteen at a very good price that anyone can afford without any hesitation or budget issues.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Solid placements, modern labs, and great campus life are provided by ADTU.

review_content.Placements: In Assam down town University, I am from the B.Tech CSE course from the 2024 batch. 85 percent of students got placed. The highest package is 12.76 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. The average package is 4.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Capgemini, and ITC. 60 percent of students got internships in companies like TCS, IntelliPaat, etc., and many converted to PPOs. There is strong training and support from the placement cell. It is solid for the northeast students.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms have AC and smart boards. Labs have more than 300 high-configuring PCs, Cisco and Microsoft labs, and 24x7 100 Mbps Wi-Fi. The library is big with digital access and is open till 10 PM. The hostel has 3-sharing rooms with attached bathrooms and Wi-Fi. The mess is hygienic and repetitive, but okay. It serves non-vegetarian food for 4 days. The canteen serves affordable and tasty food. There is a nurse on campus and a downtown hospital nearby. The college provides grounds for games like cricket, football, badminton, and basketball. It also has a gym. For the infrastructure and hostel, I would easily rate 4.5 out of 5 for Northeast.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: University is not bad, but it could be better.

review_content.Placements: In my course, we have 2 sections, A and B, with a total of 152 students. The lowest package is around 3 LPA, the average is 4 LPA, and the highest is 10-12 LPA. Top companies were Jtekt, PwC, Jaro Education, Recruit CRM, etc. I think 30 % of students got the internship. Associate software engineer was the top role offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure for my course are top-notch. We have 6-7 labs with Wi-Fi init. Every department has its own library as well as the general library of the university. But the hostel mess is a disappointment, there are fields for different kinds of games in the university.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Faculty members are really nice in this college.

review_content.Placements: The placement rate in my course is not that high. 50% student get placed in repeated companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, along with some startups. The highest package offered here is 20 LPA, while the average package is 6.5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of my college is great. The classrooms are spacious neat and clean. The food is average nutritious and hygienic, but sometime lacking variety and taste. Medical facilities are available on campus with a first aid center. Overall, everything is nice.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Really nice placement rate.

review_content.Placements: Placement in my coursework is quite decent. Around 70% to 75% of students are getting placed in reputed companies. Overall, the course offered a balanced mixture of academics, placements, and internships, preparing students fairly well for their careers by attracting more product-based companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of my course are well-maintained and supportive of learning. There are Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, computer labs with updated systems, and access to digital learning resources through the library. College has playgrounds, indoor games, and gym facilities.

review_summary.college_name: Assam Downtown University (ADTU) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty, helpful teachers. Average placement, but can achieve higher, with good infrastructure.

content.Placements: I am in B.Tech CSE, I had 62 percent in my 12th and chose ADTU to study CSE with a specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. The one campus placement offers are not that good, but not bad either. If you maintain a good GPA, then the chances of getting a good placement are higher, ranging from 3.3 LPA to 11 LPA sometimes.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good in every aspect. ADTU has Wi-Fi connection all around the campus and per classroom, smart boards and projectors per class, a library is big, has a gym, swimming pool, badminton court, football ground, and everything. The hostel facility is good too, they have a geyser, washing machines, and a dryer. You can get an AC facility in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) with IBM - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Very good college, satisfied with the infrastructure and campus out there.

content.Placements: Placement cell is good, it helps the students in placement time, and helps them to secure a good position in a company with a very decent average package. Students feel very motivated with the help of the placement cell and faculty. They give their best.
content.Infrastructure: The university is situated in a very good location with greenery and natural beauty everywhere with good views and cafes in each block and also good and hygienic food in the canteen at a very good price that anyone can afford without any hesitation or budget issues.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Solid placements, modern labs, and great campus life are provided by ADTU.

content.Placements: In Assam down town University, I am from the B.Tech CSE course from the 2024 batch. 85 percent of students got placed. The highest package is 12.76 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. The average package is 4.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Capgemini, and ITC. 60 percent of students got internships in companies like TCS, IntelliPaat, etc., and many converted to PPOs. There is strong training and support from the placement cell. It is solid for the northeast students.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms have AC and smart boards. Labs have more than 300 high-configuring PCs, Cisco and Microsoft labs, and 24x7 100 Mbps Wi-Fi. The library is big with digital access and is open till 10 PM. The hostel has 3-sharing rooms with attached bathrooms and Wi-Fi. The mess is hygienic and repetitive, but okay. It serves non-vegetarian food for 4 days. The canteen serves affordable and tasty food. There is a nurse on campus and a downtown hospital nearby. The college provides grounds for games like cricket, football, badminton, and basketball. It also has a gym. For the infrastructure and hostel, I would easily rate 4.5 out of 5 for Northeast.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: University is not bad, but it could be better.

content.Placements: In my course, we have 2 sections, A and B, with a total of 152 students. The lowest package is around 3 LPA, the average is 4 LPA, and the highest is 10-12 LPA. Top companies were Jtekt, PwC, Jaro Education, Recruit CRM, etc. I think 30 % of students got the internship. Associate software engineer was the top role offered.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure for my course are top-notch. We have 6-7 labs with Wi-Fi init. Every department has its own library as well as the general library of the university. But the hostel mess is a disappointment, there are fields for different kinds of games in the university.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members are really nice in this college.

content.Placements: The placement rate in my course is not that high. 50% student get placed in repeated companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, along with some startups. The highest package offered here is 20 LPA, while the average package is 6.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of my college is great. The classrooms are spacious neat and clean. The food is average nutritious and hygienic, but sometime lacking variety and taste. Medical facilities are available on campus with a first aid center. Overall, everything is nice.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with our university because it provides good placement.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good institute for studying in Northeast India.

reviews.review_heading: The college offers really strong placements.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and the facilities available in the university are good.

individual_reviews.title: The college has a great placements record.

content.Placements: The college has had an extremely good placements record in the past couple of years. It has 90 percent placements rate on a yearly basis. The companies that visit to recruit are the top notch companies in the industry. The college also provides us with internship facilities.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and the infrastructure that are provided to us in our college are really good and all the facilities are taken care of regularly. The quality of the food in the mess is also good and the mess is always kept clean.

individual_reviews.title: Bombay College of Pharmacy: A Comprehensive Review.

content.Placements: Less than 10 percent of the students are placed. The highest package was 25,000, and the lowest was 11.5k. The average is 14k. Top recruiting companies include Niva Bhupa, Vmarsh, etc. Fifty percent got internships through college at small local companies. Medical representative/sales is the top role offered in this course.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available. Classrooms and labs are well-equipped with all the necessary stuff. The library has good books, but due to their high strength, there is a lot of competition while issuing them. The food available in the canteen is of average quality. Excellent facility for sports like table tennis.

individual_reviews.title: Our college provides the best campus life.

content.Placements: There are various roles in the pharmacy industry like R&D, production, QA, QC, regulatory, etc. You can also own a medical shop. We can also work as hospital pharmacists in a hospital. Top recruiting companies are Cipla, Sun Pharma, IQVIA, IPCA, Lupin, Torrent, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our classrooms are digitalized according to today's world. We have the latest technology computers and screens in all classrooms. Our college is also undergoing construction and making new labs for the students. The food available in the canteen is of good quality and taste.

individual_reviews.title: BCP is overall the best college with a NIRF ranking under 25, along with the autonomous status.

content.Placements: The faculty are very good. The education is very good. The faculty are well qualified. There are many pharmaceutical companies providing placements, like Cipla, Dr. Reddy's Lab, and many more. The college appoints a special committee of some members for arranging sports and games and quizzes.
content.Infrastructure: The professors are very supportive and provide quality education. They are well qualified and are PhD holders. They provide the best education. There is a canteen at the entrance of the college only with good quality food. The sports teams are managed by the clubs in the college.

content.Other: It is one of the best pharmacy colleges in Maharashtra, faculty of the college is awesome. There are many senior teachers with vast knowledge in the field of pharmacy, along with good teachings skills. Most of the students are mainly placed in different companies with the minimum package of 1.7-2.5 lac per annum after M. Pharma. One of the problems with the college is its fees structure, it is too much, around 1.35 lacs per year. There is no hostel facility for outstation student which is also a big problem, but they can rent room near college cheaply which are easily available for boys. For girls, there are private and government hostels where they can manage their accommodation.

review_summary.college_name: CSJMU Kanpur University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: You can prefer this college, CSJM University.

content.Placements: You need to work hard in this college for placement. Some normal companies come in campus for placement, and students have no interest in being placed in such companies which came in college. You can expect 3-4 LPA only from this college. The highest package is around 12 LPA. But if you try, you can get more.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities of the college are good. Not very well, but you can manage easily. Classrooms are not well. But few classrooms are suitable for studies. In college campus, there's a huge library where you can study and find any book. The quality of mess food is good for some time, but you can prefer the hostel. Foods are oily. You can eat.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Review of CSJM - Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University.

content.Placements: Placement rate in our course is average, and it is around 55 percent. The average package offered ranges from 3-4 LPA mostly. Recruiting companies that visit our college are mostly mass recruiters like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, etc. The top role offered is a junior developer.
content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is quite good. It has AC classrooms and a big central library with a huge collection of books. Wi-Fi facility is available. The hostel's condition is decent and needs some renovation. The mess food is average. All medical facilities are provided by the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: If you are coming here for B.Tech for any reason, come and work hard.

content.Placements: Placements aren't great. However, with the help of our placement cell, placements are improving. The college is approaching reputable companies. Efforts are being made to ensure good placements. This isn't solely the college's fault. Students should also have some responsibility. If students make zero effort, placements won't happen.
content.Infrastructure: There are good facilities in my department. All the lab equipment is there. The library is very good. There is Wi-Fi facility in the entire library. The classrooms are also good. In the summer, there are a lot of problems in the classes of our department due to a lack of AC. Overall good. The hostel is also very good. The hostel people are strict. There are a lot of restrictions there. These restrictions have been imposed for the good of the children. Overall, the hostel is good. The food in the mess is average. The breakfast is fine.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good academic environment with scope for improvement in placements.

content.Placements: About 60 percent of students got placed through campus recruitment in the recent placement cycle. 12.5 LPA (approximately) is the highest package. The average package is about 3 to 3.5 LPA and the lowest package is between 1 LPA and 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS (Tata Consultancy Services), Infosys, HCL Technologies, and Samsung Electronics. 50 to 60 percent of students got internships in companies like HCL, Infosys, TCS, etc. Top roles offered are Software Developer Engineer, Trainee Engineer, Technical Support, Management Trainee, and Business Associate.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college has everything, but we just cannot enjoy it.

content.Placements: The placement scenario is not good at CSJMU till now. The placement coordinator Dr. Praveen Bhai Patel, and the placement cell are working to bring more companies for the placement drive. The main problem is with students who lack technical as well as communication skills.
content.Infrastructure: There are good labs and classrooms. There is a vast central library, which is top-notch. The hostel has a very good infrastructure, but with a lot of restrictions. There is a 75 percent attendance criteria, which is the worst for students.

admission_process.title: CSJMU Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: CSJMU admissionsto some of the courses such as BSc, MA, LLB, BA LLB, and many other courses is based on the score in the entrance exam conducted byCSJMU. While admission is granted on a merit basis to courses like MSc and BA. The university also acceptsJEE Main scores for admission to BTech. CSJMU, formerly known asKanpur University, offers 400+ degree and diploma programmes at UG and PG levels through the campus and affiliated colleges. The university provides these courses in Engineering, Law, Science, Arts, Commerce, Management, etc. The applications for all the courses shall be available on the official website of CSJMU.

CSJM University admission processincludes several steps. Candidates need to begin with registration of the course of their choice. Admission to most of the programmes is based on the merit of the aspirants in the last qualifying exam. Find below the step-wise admission details for CSJMU:
CSJMU Application Process
The mode of application is online. Eligible aspirants can apply for the course of their choice on the official website of the university.
Selection Rounds

The university selects candidates for most of the UG courses based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. For PG courses such as MBA, admission is based on CAT, MAT or SEE scores. For some of the programmes such as LLM, MCA, BPharm and M.Ed, the university may conduct an entrance exam.
Counselling

Once the selection rounds are completed, selected candidates are called for counselling and document verification. Selected candidates must confirm their seats by paying theCSJMU feeto avoid rejection.

CSJMU fee includes multiple components such as tuition, exam, admission, caution deposit, etc. Candidates are first required to pay course fee during admission to confirm their seat in the university. Talking about affordability, it is one of the reasons why many leave a degree or a college. While the availability of education loans and scholarships has made education accessible but the terms and conditions required to become eligible for a student loan or a scholarship often stand as a challenge.

paragraphs: CSJM University awards financial assistance to economically weak students through mean-based scholarships funded by the University’s distinguished alumni and philanthropic institutions. The scholarships offered to the wards with low annual parental income are 25-50 per cent of the annual fee depending upon the need of the students. Such candidates are required to provide an income certificate issued by the Tehsildar or the Magistrate.

In addition to this, Kanpur University also offers merit-based scholarships to students who have secured a minimum of 60 per cent aggregate or CPI of 6.5 out of 10 in the previous qualifying exam. The names of the students for scholarships are finalised by the University Committee that comprises every year.

reviews.review_heading: Well-qualified teacher and excellent placements.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure was awesome. The classrooms were neat and clean with comfortable benches. The labs were well-equipped with air conditioning. We had a huge library. reviews.review_heading: Our college is a famous college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our college is good. The equipment in the labs is advanced and good. The classrooms also contain projectors, which help students understand better. Wi-Fi is available. The library is good. The hostel facilities are good. The canteen is also available. There are sports facilities like cricket and volleyball.

reviews.review_heading: College is excellent and everything is good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided were Wi-Fi on campus, and more extra classes were taken at our college. Classrooms were large, and the labs were well-equipped with air-conditioned. The high library facilities provided more books. The hostel facilities were good. Canteen was also available.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college, but it has strict rules.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are average, so I suggest others not to expect high. Labs are with low infrastructure. Canteen is average, but food quality and the taste is good. It has hostel facility, and it charges Rs. 70,000 per annum. Sports and games are not available, and they can't give a cricket bat.

reviews.review_heading: CMR College of Pharmacy is a good college if you only choose to pursue your B.Pharmacy degree.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our campus is not up to the mark. Only certain departments of laboratories in our institute are well equipped. The library is also good as it provides us with various journals and the latest editions of textbooks for the students to refer. Canteen is good, but it's not up to the mark. The quality of food served keeps differing.

reviews.review_heading: I'll not recommend this course as it doesn't have scope in India and fee is also too high.
reviews.review_text: Open GATE campus with good infrastructure and green environment having play ground. College has its own hostel for boys and girls separately. Food is of good quality. Will have sports classes. But not that much regular. Each block has it's own library.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college with excellent infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides high-speed Wi-Fi with regular labs and lab equipments like laminar air flow, autoclaves, incubators, and computers. There are projectors in air-conditioned classrooms, records, viva, assignments, an excellent hostel with full security, and good infrastructure. Not only studies but sports and cultural activities are also encouraged.

individual_reviews.title: Point of all DBCOPIANs.

content.Placements: My batch consists of a total of 124 students. College provides internships in many pharmaceutical companies likeSnehal Pharma, Lupin, Oracity Life Sciences, etc. College also provides placement in various companies and industries. 70% of students got internships from college at various companies and the rest are for pharmacy shops.
content.Infrastructure: Labs and library are well-maintained in my college. Every book regarding my course is available in library. Campus includes sports grounds with various sports organized. Canteen is also good. Overall, everything is up to the mark.

individual_reviews.title: It is a good college but quite costly.

individual_reviews.title: My thoughts about my college .

content.Placements: The highest package is 6 Lacs per annum and the lowest is 3 Lacs per annum. Many companies come to recruit students from our college. faqs.question: Does Kakatiya University refund fees?
faqs.answer: There have been certain requests received from the students of various courses of different Colleges under the jurisdiction of Kakatiya University for re-imbursement of fee paid by them on cancellation of their admissions due to various reasons.In this regard, the UGC, New Delhi has issued certain guidelines vide reference cited wherein clearly stipulated to refund the entire fee paid by the students who wish to cancel their admissions within time bound Le, with a charging of 1,000/- processing fee Irrespective of regular/SFC courses.

faqs.question: Is there any way of applying offline for the Kakatiya University application form?
faqs.answer: No, only online applications are accepted at Kakatiya University. The Master of Business Administration (MBA) programme is one of the few programmes offered by the university without an offline application process.You must register on the university's website and complete the application in order to apply to Kakatiya University's MBA programme. The necessary documents, including your CAT score card, UG and PG degree mark sheets (if applicable), work experience certificate (if applicable), personal statement, and recommendation letters (2), must also be uploaded as scanned copies.April is normally the deadline for applications to Kakatiya University's MBA programme. Please go to the Kakatiya University website for additional details regarding the application procedure and deadlines.

faqs.question: Does Kakatiya University accept CAT score?
faqs.answer: The Common Admission Test (CAT) score is accepted by Kakatiya University for admission to the Master of Business Administration (MBA) programme. The university counts CAT scores among the most important considerations in the application process, along with personal statement, professional experience, and academic standing. Although it fluctuates from year to year, the minimum CAT score needed for admission to Kakatiya University's MBA programme usually falls between the 70 and 85 percentile.Kakatiya University accepts scores from the CAT in addition to those from other MBA entry tests like the XAT, GMAT, and MAT. However, the CAT is the recommended entrance exam and is thought to have more weight in the admissions process for Kakatiya University's MBA programme. It is advised that you take the CAT exam and do well if you plan to apply to Kakatiya University's MBA programme. Having a high CAT score will improve your chances of getting accepted into the course of study.

faqs.question: TS EAMCET Counselling 2025 will be conducted in how many rounds?
faqs.answer: The TS EAMCET Counselling 2025 will be conducted in three phases, namely Phase 1, Phase 2, and the Final Phase, for admission into BE/BTech/BPharma courses by the Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TSCHE) and will be managed by Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad (JNTUH). Further, TS EAMCET (now TS EAPCET) Spot Round will also be conducted for Private Unaided Engineering Colleges.

faqs.question: Does KIMS Karad offer BSc?
faqs.answer: Yes, KIMS Karadoffers a four-year, full-time BSc  programme at the UG level. Candidates pass Class 10 and Class 12 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, English and Biology with 50% aggregate taken together in Physics, Chemistry and Biology from a recognised board are eligible to apply for admission in the BSc programme. The university offers various specilisation in BSc and offers merit and entrance based admisson.

faqs.question: Can I join KIMS Karad without entrance?
faqs.answer: No, you can not join KIMS Karad without entrance exam. For admission toMBBS, BDScourses, a candidates must have passed Class 12 with Science subjects from any recognised boards, and secured a valid scoreNEET. ForBSc and MSc (Nursing)admisison, candidates requires to appear for different exam (state level or college-level).

faqs.question: Can I join KIMS directly?
faqs.answer: The undergraduate MBBS programme at Kempegowda Institute of Medical Sciences (KIMS) admits 150 students annually. It is not unlawful to enter KIMS directly for MBBS. Students who want to pursue medical education but have poor NEET scores can apply for management quota seats.Yes, you can join (KIMS) directly through the NEET exam. Admission to the undergraduate MBBS program at KIMS is based on NEET scores, and there are no restrictions on joining directly if you meet the eligibility criteria. Additionally, there are management quota seats available for students with low NEET scores who wish to pursue medicine at KIMS

Further, the median package offered during PG 2-year and PG 3-year placements 2023 stood at INR 5.63 LPA and I NR 14.1 LPA , respectively.

faqs.question: How are MBBS placements at KIMS?
faqs.answer: Hello Aspirants, If you are a KIMS student at the time of recruitment then you can expect a good job because MBBS students here get some good placements. Last year, around 80 medical students got a job with a package of approximately INR 10 LPA. The highest monthly salary received by an individual student was INR 80,000 per annum. KIMS has some good networks that benefits their students. KIMS students after completing their education goes on to work for reputed hospitals and healthcare institutions including government and private establishments, as well as NGOs. The institution's dedicated placement cell further aids students in their job search, offering support such as career counselling, resume writing assistance, and interview preparation. Hope this information helps you and if you have any further questions please come back.

faqs.question: Who are the top recruiters of KIMS?

faqs.question: Which branch is best in B.Sc at KIMS?
faqs.answer: KIMS College of Nursing offers a B.Sc. Degree in Nursing, which is a full-time four-year program with a total intake of 100 seats. The college is affiliated with the Kerala University of Health Sciences, Indian Nursing Council, New Delhi, Kerala Nurses and Midwives Council, Trivandrum, and Kerala University of Health Sciences, Thrissur. B.Sc branches at KIMS are as follows: 1. B.Sc Agriculture 2. B.Sc Horticulture. 3. B.V.Sc (Veterinary Science) 4. B.Sc Forestry. 5. B.Sc Biotechnology. B.Sc Agriculture is the best branch at KIMS.

reviews.review_heading: KVV is good place for students to study.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good. There are 2 types of hostels, like AC hostels for Rs 2,00,000 and non-AC hostels for Rs 70,000. Non-AC hostels have common washrooms, whereas AC hostels have attached washrooms. Hostel food is good. Both non-veg and veg are served. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are provided. Environment is good for students to study. Library is provided and the environment is great for students.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus life awaits.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are AC and well-equipped with all audio-visual aids required for teaching. Infrastructure is great with all amenities on campus itself. The mess serves delicious food and maintains all hygiene. The campus has a swimming pool, gym, badminton court, as well as a basketball court. On-campus, there is also an amphitheatre, salon, and bazaar.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college in terms of medical college.
reviews.review_text:
1. Our college has been granted an NAAC 'A+' grade and has been conferred with ISO 9001: 2015 certification. 
2. The infrastructure is top-notch, with not a speck of dirt lying anywhere. 
3. The Wi-Fi is quite fast, with a few exceptional days. 
4. The labs and classrooms are updated and the college has all state-of-the art equipments. 
5. The library is quite possibly one of the best aspects of our university, considering of the advanced facilities. It has a card-wiping technology for issue of ...

reviews.review_heading: An amazing college with great staff members, infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text:
The campus is located in the heart of karad city at very good location with nice atmosphere all around the area of 60 acres more or less. 
The college has modern-era infrastructure with separate buildings for various departments of dental, nursing, MBBS, physiotherapy, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfactorial experience uptill. Could work on the management and time tables.
reviews.review_text: Newly developed high-tech library with more than over 5000 books excluding medical magazines, research papers etc. Campus Wi-Fi is supported with high-speed internet that works smoothly on laptops etc. Greenery of the campus is one of the calming zone in chaotic schedule.

reviews.review_heading: This is a great college life one can have.
reviews.review_text: It provides Wi-Fi all over the campus, fully Wi-Fi zoned areas, high-tech laboratories, food quality was great. Students get breakfast, lunch, and dinner of good quality. People won't get bored of meals as they used to get a variety of meals. The mess will never disappoint students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences.
reviews.review_text: KIMS has both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned hostels. Recently a new air-conditioned hostel has been opened which is amazing and very hygienic. The warden is quite strict, and the security is also good. Recently the campus has been renovated. The library is the best part about the campus, which I don't think any other campus can provide that.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides facilities like an air-conditioned hostel, gym, swimming pool, cafeteria, air-conditioned library, and good hospital. Everything is available here. Hostels are good. Everything is nearby. The food served in the hostel is good. Classrooms, library, and everything are good and newly renovated.

reviews.review_heading: It provides excellent infrastructure and various facilities for students.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi services are very good. Library provides all types of books related to the course and reference magazines. The seating arrangement in the library is good and comfortable. Sports, gymnasium, and various outdoor games are available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences.
reviews.review_text: There is free Wi-Fi on the whole campus. The library has unlimited Wi-Fi, air-conditioner, computer zone on each floor, separate floors for UG and PG students along with 10000 books and journals, and they provide online resources also. Hostel facilities are good, and both air-conditioner and non air conditioner rooms are available.

reviews.review_heading: There is good infrastructure and teaching faculty members. There is a scope for improvement.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library and all are good here. High facilities are provided. The library is sprawled over 3 floors and has air-conditioning and drinking water. Free Wi-Fi is available to all students. The food served in the mess is just amazing. It's clean and healthy as well as tasty. The price of the food in the mess is also affordable.

reviews.review_heading: Our campus is nice, but teachers don't teach much. The library is new.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not much great. The campus is great. The library is fine, and the food court is nice. A sports week is organised, and it is average. The campus doesn't organise a lot of curricular activities, etc. It doesn't organise fests and gatherings after Covid-19 also. So, overall, our college doesn't provide good exposure. Still, the hospital OPD works well. The previous cafeteria was better. The food court is newly built.

reviews.review_heading: The college has really good infrastructure and provides fairly good education.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is amazing. It has got NABH+ accreditation. You can find the pictures on the website. It has a library with centralized AC and Wi-Fi. The hostel and mess facilities are available. The girls' hostel is on the campus itself, and but the boys' hostel is a little far from the college.

reviews.review_heading: It has the best infrastructure, campus, and a good crowd.
reviews.review_text: It has the best infrastructure. It is one of the cleanest campuses in India. The library is amazing. Our college also provides a gym, pool, basketball courts, cafeteria, well-equipped labs, museums, etc. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Hostels are very good. Both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned rooms are available in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Posh high quality education for MBBS, BDS, nursing, physiotherapy, and academics are main power.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are very good. Campus area is literally the best. But for only boys hostel of UG's its not that good. Light goes anytime, not that frequently. Central Wi-Fi is present. Library is top class. Food is also decent. For MBBS students, medical facilities are kind of free. Games and sports are not that much focused.

review_summary.college_name: Lloyd Institute of Management and Technology (Pharm.) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.title: Balanced education with practical exposure and research support.

content.Placements: Lloyd Institute of Management and Technology (pharma) provides decent placement assistance, particularly for students who take initiative and build their profile throughout the course. College has tie-ups with several pharmaceutical and healthcare companies. While the average package remains around 3 LPA, students aiming for higher studies or GPAT preparation also receive strong academic support. Internship opportunities are consistently provided in reputed hospitals, diagnostic labs, and pharmaceutical industries. Some students have also secured positions in quality control and marketing decisions. The placement cell is active.

individual_reviews.title: There is a strong foundation in Pharmacy with industry-relevant learning.

content.Placements: This institute organises a job fest every year named Niyukti, which is organised by the placement cell. More than 100 students participate in this institute. More than 50 companies come to take interviews, like Sun Pharma, Cipla, Alkem, etc. Many students are selected and offered jobs in higher positions in the biggest companies. Many alumni come to college to share their experiences.
content.Infrastructure: This college has well-decorated classrooms in which students are taught with the help of projectors. This college has many labs in which students are taught by doing practicals. All labs are well-equipped, and all kinds of machines are present in them. This college has a well-furnished and decorated library which has a maximum of books by Indian and International writers. This institute also has a playground, like a basketball court, a volleyball court, and a football field where students can play whatever they want. There is also a big parking.

individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure and facilities are very good.

content.Placements: I achieved 74%. The highest package was 8 LPA. Cipla, Zeelab, Davaindia, Akum, etc. Internship at the Delhi Government Pharmacy, compounding and dispensing of medicine. I also worked as a sales executive, manager in charge, etc. There were many academic posts available.
content.Infrastructure: Well neat and clean infrastructure, and very good educational environment. The library was so comfortable and well-hygienic place.
content.Faculty: Faculty was so good, well-educated, and had a friendly behavior with everyone. My pass percentage was also good, and I was proud to be part of this college. Thank you so much. Every half of the year, semester exams were conducted to help for the main exams, and everyone achieved an easy exam. Thank you so much for providing good staff. Special thanks to teachers.

individual_reviews.title: LIMT is not good in terms of fun.

content.Placements: In the B.Pharm. course, there are around 100 students in every batch. The lowest salary package offered is 3.5 LPA and the highest salary package offered is 7.5 LPA. About 50% of the students got internships from the college. Most of the jobs are related to marketing or sales.
content.Infrastructure: There are various facilities, and some are genuinely nice, but some are bad. Hostels are not so special, and they are just like normal hostels. They are quite uncool, with nothing special and a boring menu. Hostels have average things, and it is better to stay at PG.

individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the faculty and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Out of 120 students in my course, 100% were placed. The highest package offered was 7.5 lacs and the lowest was 3.5 lacs. Apolo Pharmacy provides internships for students in their third or fourth year.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at Lloyd Institute of Management and Technology is very good, and the facilities in the B.Pharma course are good as well. The labs are not that good, as they only have a few new labs and the rest are old. However, they have all the equipment we need for the practical component of the course. In terms of sports, they have a few games like volleyball, cricket, and badminton.

admission_process.title: Marwadi University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Marwadi University admissionto some courses is merit-based and for some courses, it is entrance-based. The University offers 25 undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral and diploma courses. The Marwadi University courses are offered in various fields such asEngineering,Management,Law, Computer Applications, etc, via different faculties. Candidates willing to secure admission atMarwadi Universitymust meet the course-specific eligibility criteria and appear for the pre-determined selection process.
Marwadi University admission to theflagship BTechcourse is done based on the candidate's performance inGUCET or JEE Main. Continue reading to learn more about the Marwadi University admission 2025.

The general eligibility criteria for Marwadi University courses is that the candidate must have passed class 12 or graduated, according to the level of course selected, in the relevant stream. Candidates seeking admission to Marwadi University must meet the course-specific eligibility criteria and go through the predetermined selection process.
The table below shows some of the popularMarwadi University coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:

Marwadi University admission processcomprises three steps starting with the registration and filling out the application form followed by appearing for the counselling process and then paying the fee to confirm admission. Interested candidates are advised to check the eligibility criteria before starting their Marwadi University admission process.
Below is the step-wise detailed admission process of Marwadi University:
Step 1: Application Process
For Marwadi University course admission, the first step is to fill out the application form by visiting the official website of the college for their desired course.
Step 2: Selection Criteria
Candidates based on valid scores in various exams accepted by the college will be shortlisted for admission rounds based on the programmes the candidate applied for.
Step 3: Final Seat Allotment

Candidates whose names appeared in the list of selected candidates in any particular programme will be required to report to the admission cell of Marwadi University for document verification and fee payment for locking their seats for that specific course.

reviews.review_heading: Kundnani college of pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: Our labs are well-equipped and we don't have separate hostels. The library is well air-conditioned, and the canteen is nice. Along with that, our college has really good exposure for people from all backgrounds. Sports and games are also really good, and the quality of food available is nice.

reviews.review_heading: Perks of being a KMKCPite.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good but there is no college campus as such. No playing ground of its own but internal is well maintained and it has a big library. The college has its own auditorium which is air conditioned and best. Good laboratories are there but always lack in chemical ingredients. There is no canteen in the college. There is a games room where students can play carom, chess and table tennis. There is also a quarantine area and medical rooms for students.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good in terms of education.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides us with good facilities. They provide good services to all. They organise various programs related to health care services and the betterment of common people.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommended joining this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good infrastructure and facilities. Our college provides facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, comfortable classrooms, etc. The food served in our college is good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with all the facilities and faculty college provide.
reviews.review_text: It's 7 floor building which includes 3-4 floor for laboratory then 2 floors for classroom and office. There is small canteen present. Then there is underground library which consists of lots of books. There is not as such ground for college but there is small indoor game room.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with the college because of its excellent teachers.
reviews.review_text: There is no canteen, but we have a good playground, library, gymkhana, and laboratory. The infrastructure of labs and classrooms is excellent and lively. The infrastructure is extremely very good. Many clubs and intercollege competitions are held. Good sunlight and fresh air enter the classroom.

reviews.review_heading: Best B.Pharma college in Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good and well maintained. Wi-Fi facilities are provided along with well-equipped classrooms. The library is quite large and very big consisting of thousands of books. However there I no canteen in our college and thus many of u all need to bring tiffin from home or you can eat at fast food restaurants.

UPUMS admission process includes multiple-steps. Candidates have to follow a specific process for each course. Below are the steps to get a seat in UPUMS:
Step 1: UPUMS Application Process 2025

Aspirants have to apply for NEET and NEET MDS for MBBS and MDS programmes, respectively. The application for MS, MD and MCh is also via accepted entrance exam. For all the other courses, candidates have to fill out the application form available on the university website.
Step 2: Selection

The university selects candidates based on national-level or university-level entrance-exam. The university conducts CPPNET for BPharm, GNM and ANM courses. UPUMS accepts NEET, NEET-MDS, NEET-PG, GPAT and NEET SS for specific courses.
Step 4: Counselling & Seat Allotment

Candidates applying for MBBS have to apply for UP NEET counselling for seat allotment. For all other courses, aspirants have to participate in the university counselling. The university releases a final merit-list announcing the seat allotted to candidates based on their entrance-exam and qualifying exam score.
